item.title: Amy Acton's estranged mom stars in a GOP attack ad. Their painful history spans decades.
item.description:
A new campaign ad in which the estranged mother of Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton argues that her daughter should not be elected as the Buckeye State's next governor has added a new level of controversy to what was already one of the most closely watched races of the midterms.

Acton, a Democrat, is running to replace outgoing Republican Gov. Mike DeWine. She's facing Republican Vivek Ramaswamy, a billionaire who ran an unsuccessful presidential campaign in 2024. 

In the ad, Acton's mother, Donna Arthur, calls her daughter a "liar" and urges Ohioans not to support her. 

"Don't let her become your governor," she says. "If you think she'll make your life better, you're fooling yourself. It will only get worse."

As the ad began to spread across social media, Acton's brother released a statement in which he accused Arthur of siding with their stepfather after he was charged with sexually abusing Acton when she was a child, and criticized Ramaswamy for attempting to use that abuse as a "political talking point." 

Ramaswamy defended the ad on Tuesday, telling reporters that Acton's account of her past "does deserve to be scrutinized." His campaign confirmed to the Enquirer that it will spend $4 million to air the ad across the state. 

The ongoing controversy over the ad, which has been widely condemned by Democrats and sparked pushback from some Republicans, has put a new spotlight on the race for Ohio's top elected office. 

Ohio Sen. Jon Husted, an incumbent Republican locked in a tight reelection race, released a statement saying he personally “would not have run” the ad. Meanwhile, Vice President JD Vance, himself a former senator from Ohio, said Republicans who disapprove of the ad should “stop whining” and remember that politics is a “tough business” during a campaign stop in Cincinnati on Wednesday.

Once a key swing state, Ohio has steadily become redder in recent decades. Four years ago, DeWine won reelection by more than 25 percentage points. But polls suggest that Acton has a chance to break the GOP's long run of control over the Ohio Statehouse.

Here's what you need to know about who she is, how her past informs what she stands for today and what the polls say about her chances of winning. 

Who is Amy Acton?

Acton has been open about the "difficult" childhood she endured growing up in Youngstown, Ohio, in the 1970s. On her campaign website, she says she overcame "periods of abuse, hunger, and neglect, and even wound up living in a tent in the middle of winter." 

In 2019, she publicly discussed for the first time that she had been sexually assaulted by her stepfather, Cledith Arthur, between the ages of 9 and 12. After Acton's biological father reported the abuse in 1978, Arthur was arrested and charged with rape, according to contemporary news reports and court documents obtained by the Associated Press. Acton's mother sided with her stepfather, disputing the allegations of abuse. The couple left the state before Arthur could face trial and allegedly remained together until his death in 2004.

Both Acton and her mother say they have not seen or spoken to each other since a court hearing in which Acton testified against her stepfather nearly 50 years ago.

"In the courthouse after they were charged, I went to give her a kiss, and she just turned her cheek away. That was the last time I ever saw her," Acton told the now-shuttered newspaper the Vindicator in 2019. 

Acton found more stability after moving in with her father and became a standout student in high school. She earned a bachelor's degree from Youngstown State University and a medical degree from the Northeast Ohio School of Medicine, working various jobs to pay her way through college. She completed residencies in pediatrics and preventive medicine before becoming a professor at Ohio State University, where she taught classes on maternal and child health. She also directed a community organization called Project L.O.V.E. to promote preventive health care among Columbus-area children.

In 2019, DeWine tapped her to become director of the Ohio Department of Health. When the COVID-19 pandemic hit a year later, she advised DeWine to take swift action to control the spread of the virus. Under her guidance, Ohio became the first state in the nation to shut down all public schools. Acton also gained national attention thanks to the daily public briefings she gave throughout the early stages of the pandemic. In May 2020, an opinion piece in the New York Times called her "The Leader We Wish We All Had." 

Acton resigned a month later amid pressure from the Republican-led state legislature to sign orders rolling back COVID restrictions, moves she would later say "there was no science for." She briefly remained part of DeWine's administration as a public health adviser before leaving to resume working in the nonprofit sector. 

She announced her plans to run for governor in early 2025 and cruised through the Democratic primary in May.

Acton was married to her first husband, with whom she had three children, for nearly 20 years before they divorced in 2008. She married her current husband in 2010 and became stepmother to his three children. 

What does Acton stand for?

As a Democrat running in a conservative-leaning state, Acton fits firmly into the moderate wing of her party. Her policy platform focuses heavily on affordability, including proposals to lower the cost of health care, combat fraud, cut high energy bills and crack down on corporations that take advantage of workers and consumers. 

In July, she drew criticism from some progressive Democrats for saying that she supported barring transgender children from participating in girls' and women's sports. Soon afterward, she added language to her website pledging to protect Ohio's LGBTQ community, without directly contradicting her previously stated stance on transgender athletes' participation in sports. Acton has also spoken in favor of Ohio's voter ID requirements, a position that puts her at odds with many Democrats who view such laws as a voter suppression tactic by Republicans. 

Acton has also called for an increase in funding for police departments, more money for public schools and heavy investment in Ohio's rural and farming communities. 

What are her chances?

Polling in the Ohio governor's race has fluctuated significantly as Election Day has grown closer. In the aggregate, the polls suggest that Acton has steadily widened her lead over Ramaswamy over the past several weeks. At the same time, two polls released in October show Ramaswamy ahead. The Cook Political Report and the Center for Politics, two of the country's top nonpartisan forecasters, list the race as a toss-up.

No polls of the race have been conducted since the ad featuring Acton's mother became public, so it's too early to gauge what impact — if any — the controversy might have on voters' views of the two candidates.

This article originally appeared on Yahoo News at https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/article/who-is-amy-acton-the-ohio-gubernatorial-candidate-at-the-center-of-a-campaign-ad-controversy-involving-her-estranged-mother-193022496.html

item.title: 金融时报：日本化，中国经济无法避免的前景？
item.description:
并不是所有人都相信这种政策转向能够轻松实现。 正如两代日本人承受了1980年代泡沫破裂的后果，如今中国年轻一代也正在承受国内经济放缓带来的最大冲击。 龙洲经讯分析师白安儒估计，自2022年以来，约有7400万中国人完成学业并进入劳动力市场。 他认为，经济疲弱会让这批“失落的一代”中的许多人对未来感到失望，也让稳定房地产市场变得更加困难。 高盛分析师认为，在判断日本化可能对中国造成多大冲击时，这种心理阴影甚至比人口结构恶化更为重要。 在日本，当家庭和企业看不到长期增长前景时，就会减少消费和投资。 消费和投资减少又会进一步压低增长预期，最终形成恶性循环。经济学家将这种现象称为“预期传导机制”。 经济学家、《中国房地产泡沫》一书作者朱宁说，年轻人“根本不认为买房在经济上或投资上是合理的，因为他们经历的全部现实就是，短短五年内，房价下跌了30%至40%”。

item.title: Super Typhoon Champi intensifies into one of the year's most powerful storms
item.description:
Super Typhoon Champi, which is barreling across the western Pacific Ocean, became one of the strongest storms on Earth in 2026 on Wednesday.

The tropical cyclone tied April’s Super Typhoon Sinlaku for the strongest 1-minute sustained winds of 2026, at 185 mph, which is equivalent to a Category 5 hurricane.

Hurricanes and typhoons are both tropical cyclones with sustained winds of at least 74 mph. 

“A tropical cyclone is a generic term used by meteorologists to describe a rotating, organized system of clouds and thunderstorms that originates over tropical or subtropical waters and has closed, low-level circulation,” according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.

The main difference between hurricanes and typhoons is geographic: Storms in the Northwest Pacific are called typhoons, while those in the North Atlantic and central and eastern North Pacific are called hurricanes.

The Joint Typhoon Warning Center classifies a storm as a super typhoon when its 1-minute sustained winds reach at least 150 mph. That threshold falls within the Category 4 hurricane range.

What is Champi’s path?

Champi is currently east of the Philippines and southeast of Taiwan, moving west-northwest across the Philippine Sea at 15 mph. Maximum sustained winds are at 175 mph, after peaking at 185 mph, according to the latest update from the National Weather Service.

The storm is forecast to make a slight turn toward the northwest and weaken through Thursday.

What are the expected impacts?

Champi is expected to bring heavy rain and strong winds to parts of Taiwan and eastern China through the weekend, according to AccuWeather senior meteorologist Jason Nicholls.

Heavy rain is expected to affect Taiwan from Thursday night (Oct. 22) into Saturday (Oct. 24) and east-central China from Friday night (Oct. 23) through Sunday (Oct. 25). Rainfall is forecast to total up to 18 inches, with the heaviest rain expected in northeastern Taiwan.

The heavy rain could cause flooding, mudslides, structural damage and transportation delays, according to AccuWeather.

Strong winds from Champi, with wind gusts up to 120 mph, are expected to affect Taiwan and eastern China from Thursday night into Sunday. The winds could cause structural damage, prolonged power outages and transportation delays.

This article originally appeared on Yahoo News at https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather-news/article/super-typhoon-champi-becomes-one-of-2026s-strongest-storms-as-it-heads-toward-taiwan-and-eastern-china-212554537.html

社会


中央气象台预计，今天起，我国中东部气温自北向南开始陆续反弹。23日前后，东北、西北地区东部多地最高气温将升至15℃以上，华北、黄淮可达20℃左右。
市场监管总局（国家标准委）近日批准发布《交通管理电子证照机动车行驶证》国家标准，将自2027年4月1日起实施。
21日，2026年世界科技与发展论坛发布“十大科技前瞻”，分别是面向原创科学发现的自主科研智能体、强人工智能安全与价值对齐等。
21日，在2026年体操世锦赛男子团体决赛中，中国体操男队凭借第三名的成绩成功锁定洛杉矶奥运会参赛席位。
21日，世界最大跨径公轨两用悬索桥——重庆黄桷沱长江大桥顺利实现主桥钢桁梁合龙。
公安部网安局查明，网传“艺人肖某演唱会第一排门票25万元”消息不实。发布谣言的网民王某某被行政拘留七日并处一千元罚款。
京津冀氢能综合应用试点城市群21日正式启动，将推广氢燃料电池汽车不少于1.2万辆，加氢站保有量超过100座。
21日，第32届中国义乌国际小商品博览会开幕。展会吸引2770家企业参展，将持续到24日。
9月份，山西原煤产量达到7882.6万吨，创下近四个月产量新高。

声音



最近，特斯拉发布“会飞的汽车”，引发热议。有人惊呼“我们被甩开了”；也有人嗤之以鼻，称其不过是“蹦高的大号玩具”。两种论断各走极端，过于武断。人民锐评发文：从汽车大国迈向汽车强国，需要的不是样样都赢，而是怀有一种包容平视的心态，创造一种引领带动的格局。未来出行是一场未被定义的长跑，我们乐见更多可能性。眼里有竞合、脚下有定力、心中有格局，集中精力做好自己的事，中国汽车的发展之路，定会越走越宽广。（阅读原文）


生活服务



天气：今天，新疆北疆阿勒泰山区、塔城高海拔山区、沿天山地区和伊犁河谷、青海东南部、西藏东部等地部分地区有大到暴雪或雨夹雪，其中，新疆伊犁河谷东部局地特大暴雪。云南中南部、台湾岛北部等地部分地区有中到大雨，其中，台湾岛东北部局地有暴雨或大暴雨。
北京：中国国家博物馆“英名永存 薪火长歌——纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年文物联展”将于10月31日起正式对公众展出，观众可以实名预约参观。
天津：市住房公积金管理中心发布通知，新增自住住房物业费、新购自住住房装修费和自住住房装修翻新费提取情形。


早安中国



今年是红军长征胜利90周年。面对生死存亡的严峻考验，从1934年10月至1936年10月，红军第一、第二、第四方面军和第二十五军进行了伟大的长征。这一惊天动地的革命壮举，是中国共产党和红军谱写的壮丽史诗，是中华民族伟大复兴历史进程中的巍峨丰碑。让我们紧跟先辈们的步伐，发愤图强，矢志奋斗！


新的一天，早安！

item.title: Early voting surges in states that could decide Senate control
item.description:
WASHINGTON (AP) — Voter turnout is soaring compared with the last midterm election in many of the states that are expected to decide control of the U.S. Senate, according to an Associated Press analysis of early voting two weeks before Election Day.

In Texas, early voting is up 74% compared with 2022. In Kansas it’s more than doubled. Maine, North Carolina and Ohio also have seen increases of more than 30% in early in-person and mail voting compared with the same point in 2022.

Democrats are trying to flip Republican-held Senate seats in each of those states. In most of them, Republicans are accounting for a smaller share of advance voters than they did four years ago.

The AP’s data, which runs through Tuesday, gives a snapshot of potential voter enthusiasm — and where it might be lacking — after early voting has opened in most states during a midterm cycle that has shifted in often unpredictable ways.

Dissatisfaction with President Donald Trump’s tariffs, the persistently high cost of living, and high gas and diesel prices caused by the Iran war have generated political blowback against Republicans in places the party didn’t anticipate having to defend this year.

Nationally, more than 13 million mail-in and early in-person votes have been cast, compared with 9 million at the same point in 2022. The increase also reflects a few additional states that expanded their early voting opportunities and ones that made more of their data available since the last midterms.

Midterm elections typically favor the party out of power in Washington. With Republicans in control of both chambers of Congress and the White House, it's a distinctly different environment than 2022, when Democrats were in charge.

Democrats energized by competitive Senate races in GOP-leaning states

Senate Democrats were expected to face a tough map this cycle, defending a number of battlegrounds with only a few opportunities to flip seats in areas Trump won by single digits in 2024. Republicans currently hold a 53-47 majority in the chamber.

But with gas and diesel prices up significantly from where they were a year ago and Trump increasingly unpopular among voters, Democrats have been wading into traditionally Republican states, hoping to win there for the first time in decades.

Earlier this month, Republicans pulled back spending in a once-competitive North Carolina Senate race and dumped close to $12 million into Kansas, a state Trump won by 16 percentage points in 2024, to support GOP Sen. Roger Marshall against Democrat Adam Hamilton.

Trump held a rally Monday in the state, where more than 55,000 people have cast their ballots so far — more than double the 27,000 people who had voted at this point in the cycle in 2022. That year, Democratic Gov. Laura Kelly narrowly won reelection while Republican Sen. Jerry Moran won overwhelmingly.

Specific races seem to be drawing voters to the polls

Texas also has seen a massive surge, even though early in-person voting just started Monday. The number of ballots cast two weeks from Election Day has reached nearly 1 million, up from roughly 550,000 at the same stage in 2022. Texas’ data doesn’t show ballots returned by party registration.

The surge comes as Democrat James Talarico and Republican state Attorney General Ken Paxton compete for the Senate seat currently held by GOP Sen. John Cornyn, whom Paxton defeated in a primary runoff with Trump’s endorsement.

Democrats have targeted Paxton, who is benefiting from millions in outside spending, over corruption allegations and his impeachment by the Texas Legislature, though he was later acquitted.

Talarico is trying to become the first Democrat to win statewide in more than three decades. Incumbent GOP Gov. Greg Abbott also is in an election fight against Democratic state lawmaker Gina Hinojosa.

Ohio has top races up and down the ballot this year, with tight contests for U.S. Senate, House and governor. Total spending on the Ohio Senate race will reach close to $500 million, according to AdImpact.

The increased attention is reflected in the votes, with 156,000 more ballots cast so far compared with 2022, a 30% increase. Some voting laws have changed in Ohio since 2022, including the state eliminating its grace period for receiving mail ballots, a change that forces voters to return those ballots earlier.

In Maine, where five-term Republican Sen. Susan Collins is seeking reelection against Democrat Troy Jackson, there’s been an increase of 39% in ballots cast this year compared with two weeks before the election in the 2022 midterm.

Advance vote hasn't increased in every competitive state

In Michigan and Georgia, two states where Democrats are defending Senate seats, the total number of early votes cast is high, but similar to four years ago.

Both states shattered their midterm voting records in 2022, with reproductive rights on the ballot in Michigan and a highly competitive U.S. Senate race in Georgia that year.

Iowa, which voted three times for Trump in presidential years, has competitive contests for governor, Senate and in three of its four House districts. Early voting there two weeks out from the election is down about 6% from the same period four years ago.

___

Ryan Dubicki and Michaela Herbst of The Associated Press Election Services team contributed to this report from Washington.

This article originally appeared on Associated Press at https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/many-states-could-determine-control-215938070.html

item.title: 我们的长征
item.description:
‌今天是红军长征胜利90周年纪念日

89年前埃德加·斯诺

在《红星照耀中国》中

评价长征是

“现代史上无与伦比的一次远征”

岁月流转，烽火远去

‌长征精神不但没有褪色

反而在人类历史中愈加熠熠生辉

曾重走长征路的

澳大利亚汉学家‌魏华德‌说

“长征犹如贯穿中国现代史的脊梁”

“就所历经的艰难困苦而言

这可能是人类有史以来

关于坚韧毅力的最伟大篇章”


一


1934年10月10日

中共中央、中革军委

率中央红军主力等

从瑞金出发

进行战略转移，开始长征

近92年后的2026年9月6日

G3998次复兴号列车驶出瑞金站

运行11小时32分钟

跨越1857公里抵达延安

长征出发地与长征胜利落脚点

首次实现高铁直达

“雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越”

当年红军跨越千山万水

冲破围追堵截

以钢铁般的意志走完两万五千里长征

如今中国公路总里程超557万公里

铁路营业里程达16.5万公里

高铁运营里程突破5万公里

交通四通八达

现代化程度远超先辈设想



二


1935 年 1 月遵义会议后

红军四渡赤水，巧渡金沙

书写了一段段可歌可泣的英勇故事

如今激流险滩、高山峡谷之上

长虹横跨，巨龙震撼同框

数桥飞架南北，天堑变通途

一座座水电站拔地而起

成为我国清洁能源开发的重要战场

截至2026年5月底

我国发电装机达40.1亿千瓦

规模位居全球首位

超过美国、欧盟、印度

日本、俄罗斯的装机总和

娄山关巍峨、赤水河滔滔

90年，神州奋楫启新篇



三


1935年5月

红一团营长孙继先带领17名勇士

冒着枪林弹雨强渡大渡河

为全军打开一条胜利的道路

23年后的1958年

孙继先奉命率领兵团开赴大西北

在茫茫戈壁滩开建导弹试验基地

此地后来发展为酒泉卫星发射中心

1970年4月24日

长征一号运载火箭

从酒泉一飞冲天

成功把“东方红一号”送入太空

从雪山草地到戈壁惊雷

从神舟飞天到天宫建站

从北斗组网到“嫦娥”揽月

如今，中国人星辰大海的

新长征不断向前



四


1936年10月22日

红军三大主力完成会师

宣告长征胜利结束

红军用“小米加步枪”

冲破重重封锁

谱写出人类历史上

无与伦比的英雄史诗

长征路上，缺枪少弹、装备简陋

每一颗子弹都弥足珍贵

如今的中国，巡天有隐身战机

向海有航母劈波

长空有导弹列阵

云端有卫星和无人机俯瞰

陆海空天一体的现代化作战体系

守护着祖国的万里山河



五


90 年弹指一挥间

从不被看好，到惊艳世界

有一种力量

可以超越装备的差距

超越环境的极限

改变命运的绝境

这力量，是向死而生的勇气

是矢志不渝的信仰

是永不言弃的执着

长征精神已经深深融入

中国的血脉

夹金山雪依旧，源上水长清

90年华夏巨变

如今的中国突破一个个困难

在自立自强、民族复兴的道路上

跋山涉水、勇毅前行

前路依然会遭遇险滩暗礁

依然要面对风高浪急

但我们不畏风浪、迎难而上

扛起我们的使命

走好我们这一代人的长征！



审核 | 周扬

编辑 | 张释之

校对 | 吴锦

item.title: Trump admin. seeks emergency Supreme Court order to restart Texas border wall
item.description:
By Andrew Chung

Oct 21 (Reuters) - President Donald Trump's administration asked the US Supreme Court on Wednesday to let it proceed with a plan to build a US-Mexico border ‌barrier in a remote region in West Texas that includes Big Bend National Park.

The ‌Justice Department filed an emergency request for the court to lift a federal judge's order halting wall construction in the region ​while a lawsuit against the project brought by an environmental group and other challengers plays out.

The Republican president has long touted building or reinforcing barriers along the US-Mexico border as a signature part of his anti-immigration policies. But his administration's push to extend border infrastructure into the national park, around 250 miles (400 ‌km) southeast of El Paso, has ⁠faced opposition from local officials, conservationists and some Texas Republicans.

The lawsuit was brought by the Center for Biological Diversity, a Big Bend-area river guide and a ⁠group seeking to preserve a historic church in Ruidosa, Texas, that says its fragile adobe structure is threatened by the border construction.

The plaintiffs challenged a series of waivers issued by the US Department of Homeland ​Security to ​expedite construction of roads and barriers in the Big ​Bend region, avoiding the application of ‌a variety of environmental and conservation laws.

Former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and the current Secretary Markwayne Mullin, who issued the waivers between February and July, found the region to be an "area of high illegal entry," requiring additional barriers to control the border.

US District Judge Kathleen Cardone in El Paso issued an injunction on October 2 halting the construction. In an opinion issued later, the judge found ‌that the waivers exceeded the authority of Noem and ​Mullin.

The Justice Department in its request urged the Supreme Court ​to pause or overturn Cardone's injunction.

"Even assuming ​that the secretary's waiver authority implicates a question of 'vast economic and political significance,' ‌Congress did clearly authorize the secretary both ​to build border barriers and ​to waive legal requirements in order to facilitate their expeditious construction," the Justice Department wrote.

In August, the administration paused construction in Big Bend after the project drew bipartisan criticism over ​its potential impact on the ‌park's landscape and wildlife. Crews had begun clearing land in the park for roads and ​border security infrastructure, prompting protests and lawsuits seeking to halt the work.

(Reporting by Andrew ​Chung in New York; Editing by Will Dunham)

This article originally appeared on Reuters at https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/trump-asks-us-supreme-court-220351669.html

item.title: 今天，纪念伟大胜利！
item.description:
1934年10月

赣南，于都河畔

8.6万人的红色大军

背起行囊，跨过浮桥

开启了一场伟大的远征


江西赣州市于都河东门渡口。王群/摄

 

中国工农红军

第一方面军出发一个月后

红二十五军离开大别山

第二年3月

红四方面军西渡嘉陵江

11月，红二、六军团撤离湘西

先后踏上战略转移的漫漫征程


90年前的今天

1936年10月22日

红二方面军

抵达将台堡（今属宁夏西吉）

与红一方面军胜利会师

作为红军三大主力会师的收官之章

这场伟大远征胜利结束


宁夏固原市西吉县红军长征将台堡会师纪念碑

 

这场伟大的远征

有一个不朽的名字——

长征

 

长征，是一条漫长的路

一条用一双双脚板走出来的路

总行程65000余里

历时2年多

把中国革命从绝境引向新生

 

4支长征大军

出发时总人数为20.6万

沿途补充兵力1.7万人

到长征结束仅剩5.7万人

仅红一方面军

平均每300米就有一名战士倒下


这条路上

有艰苦卓绝的行进

有生死攸关的战斗

有运筹帷幄的决策

有绝处逢生的胜利

充满着任何想象

都难以描摹出来的奇迹


陕西延安市吴起县中央红军长征胜利纪念园

 

一支年轻鲜活的队伍

 

支撑起这场奇迹的

是一群年轻人

长征途中

红军师以上干部的年龄

绝大部分都在二三十岁

红军将领的平均年龄仅25岁

美国传记作家R·特里尔也这样记述

“大约54％的长征者

都是24岁以下的年轻人。”

可以说

长征是一群年轻人走出来的

 

越是高山雪寒

越见红军魄力

翻攀雪山时

战士们喝辣椒汤御寒

将雪做成“冰淇淋”

晚间露宿没有被褥

他们笑谈

“过雪山，我们是顶天立地；

过草地，我们又是盖天铺地，

我们不愧是天地的主人！”


红军战士在跳高。新华社发（埃德加·斯诺 摄）

 

在艰苦的征途之上

他们依旧葆有少年般的烂漫

困苦困不住心胸

磨难磨灭不了蓬勃的生命力

 

这群鲜活的年轻人

转战14个省份

走遍了大半个中国

在极其艰苦恶劣的生存环境下

抗击着敌人10多支部队、

数十万大军的围追堵截

 

1934年冬，湘江战役

是红军长征中的悲壮一幕

长征出发时

红军中有两万多闽西儿女

担任中央红军总后卫的红34师

6000多人主要是闽西子弟

湘江一战几乎全师牺牲


广西桂林市全州县红军长征湘江战役纪念馆


29岁的师长陈树湘

身负重伤，不幸被俘

在押送途中

他用手指扒开腹部的伤口

掏出肠子绞断

血尽气绝，壮烈牺牲

用年轻的生命践行了

“为苏维埃流尽最后一滴血”的誓言


油画《陈树湘》（图片来源：红军长征湘江战役纪念馆）

 

一场惊心动魄的战事

 

1935年5月29日

大渡河上的泸定桥

13根玄黑冰冷的铁索寒光凛凛

悬在滔滔江水之上

桥板几乎被守敌拆光

 

敌人以为这样就能吓退红军

却低估了红军夺桥的决心

22名勇士站了出来，组成突击队

连长廖大珠冲在最前

一边攀索一边吼“跟我上！”


油画《飞夺泸定桥》（刘国枢，1959）

 

子弹打在铁链上

火星迸溅

守敌又点燃堆在桥头的木板

铁索被烧得滚烫

勇士们攀着铁索

一寸一寸往前挪

有的中弹，掉进大渡河

连名字都没能留下


四川甘孜州，红军飞夺泸定桥雕塑。

 

战士们穿过火海扑上桥头

与敌人展开白刃肉搏

傍晚时分

红旗插上了泸定城头

 

红军对命令不折不扣的执行

不怕苦不怕死的勇气

不抛弃不放弃的团结

坚定的理想信念和强大的意志力

让长征这条路

注定通往胜利


一次伟大的会师

 

强渡大渡河、飞夺泸定桥

为红军打开了北上的通道

而这条路之所以能走通

在几个月前的贵州遵义

就已经埋下了伏笔

 

遵义会议在最危急关头

挽救了党、挽救了红军、

挽救了中国革命

是党的历史上

一个生死攸关的转折点


油画《1935年遵义会议》

 

“群龙得首自腾翔

路线精通走一行”

有了坚强的领导核心

和正确的路线指引

红军战士们

四渡赤水、巧渡金沙江

……


四渡赤水战役遗址：四川古蔺县太平渡渡口


此后

冲破数十万敌军的围追堵截

爬雪山、过草地

一路向北，克服艰难险阻

1936年10月

会宁与将台堡

成了这条漫长征途的终点

 

会宁城里

彩旗飘舞，人头攒动

有文章这样描述

“这座偏僻的小城

从来没有像今天这么热闹过。

放眼城中，几乎成了红军的海洋，

大伙只要见了面，

无论认识与否，

都激动地拥抱在一起，

久久不肯松开。”


油画《三大主力会师》


将台堡的旷野上

经历了长征洗礼的红军战士

远远望见对方的身影

都情不自禁地大喊

“我们胜利会师了！”

奔跑、拥抱、泪水、

汗水、激动、笑容

都凝聚在了将台堡

 

长征胜利结束

中国革命从此翻开了新的一页

 

一条见证时代新篇的路

 

从湘江血战的九死一生

到遵义会议的峰回路转

从飞夺泸定桥的奋不顾身

到六盘山下的红旗漫卷

……

今天

身处日新月异的中华大地

回望这条彪炳史册的长路

仍让人心潮起伏


九十年前

红军肩扛使命、脚着草鞋

从江西瑞金走到陕西延安

跋涉千山万水


九十年后

高铁直通两座圣地

1857公里，11小时32分

“复兴号”朝发夕至

平稳高效通达

变的是速度与时空

不变的是这条路

带给我们的精神力量


 

在北京长安街建国门西北角

“长征赓续”花坛静静伫立

红军长征的剪影、盛放的向日葵

映衬着

“中国工农红军长征胜利九十周年”大字

往来行人驻足

仿佛一抬头

就能望见那支跋涉在雪山草地间的队伍


 

在江西瑞金革命烈士陵园

一面英烈墙上

刻着一排排名字

走近细看，令人心头一震

刘腊梨脑、刘早狗子、吴细豆子……

这些“不像名字的名字”

源自当地

“没成年的孩子不起大名”的旧俗

许多参观者从墙前

缓缓走过，久久凝立


图源：央视新闻

 

长征

不只是一段过去的路

更是我们正在走的路


九十年岁月流转

前方还会有新的“雪山”“草地”

等待翻越

还会有新的“娄山关”“腊子口”

等待征服

属于我们这一代人的长征路

仍在延续


 观众参观“伟大的远征——纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年主题展览”。新华社记者 林秋锦 摄


今天

我们纪念中国工农红军

长征胜利90周年

致敬长征先辈

铭记峥嵘岁月


也提醒自己

勿忘历史，记得来路

不负期待，继续前行


来源：人民日报微信，综合《人民日报》、人民日报客户端江西频道等

item.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion after jury finds company liable for deceiving users
item.description:
By Diana Novak Jones

Oct 21 (Reuters) - A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta Platforms on Wednesday to pay the state $25 billion after a jury found the company had misled consumers about the privacy of their data, hitting the company with one of the largest financial penalties in US history.

The ruling came in a ‌case stemming from allegations that Cambridge Analytica, a British political consulting firm involved in Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign, obtained data from millions of Facebook users without their ‌consent. New Mexico had sued Meta, accusing it of lying to Facebook users in New Mexico about who had access to their data.

"Facebook's wrongdoing — over the course of years and systematically broadcast to the public — goes to the ​heart of Facebook's core business practices," Judge Francis Mathew wrote in his order, which came more than three weeks after the verdict.

Mathew found that a penalty of more than $219 billion was warranted based on state law, but he reduced the figure to $25 billion.

In a statement, C.J. Mahoney, Meta's chief legal officer, said the company is confident it will win on appeal.

“This ruling, and the Attorney General's approach to this enforcement, makes it all but impossible to do business in the state of New Mexico," Mahoney said. "At its core, this lawsuit seeks to impose a tax on speech to enforce new ‌rules for what people can say online."

New Mexico Attorney General Raúl ⁠Torrez said in a statement after the ruling the penalty was one of the largest financial penalties against a corporation in US history.

Meta previously faced a $5 billion penalty from the US Federal Trade Commission in 2019 over the Cambridge Analytica scandal.

Six other states settled their lawsuits against Meta related ⁠to Cambridge Analytica for $459.2 million as part of a $17.1 billion multistate settlement the company reached in August to resolve states' claims that the company's platforms had harmed teen mental health.

LAWSUIT FILED FIVE YEARS AGO

New Mexico's attorney general sued Meta in 2021 following revelations that Cambridge Analytica had harvested personal data from as many as 87 million Facebook users through a third-party app.

The state accused Meta of lying to Facebook users ​in ​New Mexico about who had access to their data and its handling of hate speech and misinformation posted ​on the platform. It alleged the company knew third parties had broad ‌access to users' data and tolerated hate speech or other harmful content when it benefited the company's bottom line.

Cambridge Analytica, now defunct, used the data for voter profiling and targeting.

"It has been a long time coming holding Big Tech accountable," Torrez told a press conference in Albuquerque after Wednesday's ruling. "I think today's judgment is a clear break with that past and a very clear warning to those in this space and beyond that we intend to protect our people and protect our consumers."

Mathew's decision comes as Meta faces thousands of lawsuits and pressure from lawmakers over the impact of Instagram and Facebook on teen mental health, with another trial slated to begin next week.

Earlier this year, New Mexico won $942 million in a pair of trials against Meta over ‌claims it facilitated sexual exploitation of young people on Instagram and Facebook and misled consumers about the ​platforms' safety.

Analyst Gil Luria, head of technology research at D.A. Davidson & Co, called the latest New Mexico ruling costly ​but unlikely to impact the company's value.

"Meta is worth nearly two trillion dollars, and ​will likely continue to appeal these cases and drag them out," Luria said.

EXPERTS EXPECT LONG APPEAL FIGHT

Jurors in September had found that the company and ‌its leadership made 26 misleading statements on data privacy, hate speech and ​other subjects. Multiplying those statements by their potential ​audience, they said the company had committed more than 43 million violations of New Mexico’s consumer protection laws.

At a hearing on October 1, Randi McGinn, a lawyer for New Mexico, had asked Mathew to award the state between $35 billion and $40 billion.

"This court should speak to Meta in the only language it understands, which is money, and the ​value of its stock price," McGinn said.

In court filings, Meta urged ‌Mathew to cap the penalties at $3.45 billion. The evidence showed that Meta does not sell user data and New Mexico did not prove that any consumer had ​actually been misled, the company said in court filings.

(Reporting by Diana Novak Jones in Chicago, additional reporting by Andrew Hay in New Mexico and Jaspreet Singh ​and Anzar Mehraj in Bangalore. Editing by Alexia Garamfalvi, Nia Williams, Aurora Ellis and Stephen Coates)

item.title: Washington orders U.S. embassy staff to leave Saudi Arabia after near-daily Houthi attacks
item.description:
The United States has ordered non-essential US embassy staff and their families to leave Saudi Arabia, the State Department said on Wednesday, as the kingdom comes under sustained deadly attacks by Yemen's Houthis.

"Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure resulting in civilian casualties and severe travel disruptions," State Department spokesman Tommy Pigott said in a social media post explaining the measure.

"The safety and security of Department personnel and their families remain our highest priority," he added.

A diplomatic source in the Middle East told AFP that some families of US embassy personnel were also being withdrawn in the United Arab Emirates, Jordan, Qatar and Bahrain, but Pigott stressed that Wednesday's order was for the departure of non-emergency embassy staff and their families in Saudi Arabia only.

Saudi Arabia has this month come under near-daily attacks from the Iran-backed Houthis, including a strike on Riyadh's international airport that was the kingdom's deadliest in years, as the war with the group escalates.

On Wednesday, the Saudi energy ministry said that falling debris from the successful interception of a drone targeting an oil facility killed two people and injured a further two.

"The attempted attack resulted in the deaths of two individuals, a Filipino and a Nepali, and injuries to two others," the ministry said in a statement.

It did not say who launched the drone aimed at Shaybah oil field near the UAE border. Earlier on Wednesday, the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen reported intercepting six drones.

One person was killed and eight others wounded in an attack on Dammam airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, aviation officials said.

In June, a four-year-old truce in Yemen's civil war collapsed, reviving the conflict that dates back to 2014. The Saudi-led coalition has backed the internationally recognized government since 2015.

- Iran explosions -

The US previously ordered non-essential staff to leave the Gulf ahead of the start of its war against Iran in late February and again in July before US President Donald Trump called off a new wave of strikes.

Late on Wednesday, Iranian state media reported the sound of explosions in the southern Hormozgan province overlooking the Strait of Hormuz, breaking a spell of relative calm.

"A few minutes ago, the sound of several explosions was heard in the Karpan area of Sirik, in Hormozgan Province," the official IRNA news agency said.

It added that "local sources have not yet disclosed the nature of these explosions."

In late February, the United States and Israel launched attacks on Iran, killing the country's supreme leader, along with senior military commanders.

Iran has attempted to blockade the Strait of Hormuz, demanding all ships seek its authorization to cross. In peacetime, the strategic waterway carried around a fifth of the world's oil supplies.

In retaliation, the United States has imposed a counterblockade on Iranian ports and ships.

bur/gh/sst

This article originally appeared on AFP at https://www.yahoo.com/news/us/articles/washington-orders-us-embassy-staff-203401687.html

item.title: Peter Thiel breaks with Trump over Iran war: 'We should not have done it'
item.description:
Billionaire technology investor Peter Thiel said he’s skeptical of the U.S. war with Iran and does not believe the United States should have launched it, putting the major Republican donor at odds with President Donald Trump over one of the administration’s defining foreign policy decisions.

Thiel's remarks, delivered on Oct. 12 at a private event, are his most explicit statements to be revealed publicly about the war with Iran and come less than two weeks before the midterm elections in which Trump's party is grasping to maintain power in Congress. The audio of Thiel's comments was obtained by Decoded by POLITICO from a lecture earlier this month.

“I’m skeptical of [the war], I think we should not have done it," Thiel said. "There were a lot of mistakes that were made.”

Thiel added, “Maybe we don’t have the hard power. Maybe we’re going to lose the soft power war.”

In the full lecture, Thiel made clear his strong opposition to neoconservatives and Middle East wars. Despite his criticism of the Iran war, Thiel highlighted his continued support of Trump and suggested he wanted to protect the president.

Still, Thiel's break over the war represents one of the most important examples to date of a fierce Trump ally sharing deep concerns about the conflict.

The comments were part of Thiel's lecture series in Nashville, which Decoded has documented since their start this fall. In the latest lecture, Thiel issued extensive warnings about what he described as the unchecked power of the International Criminal Court, drawing on comments from Bush-era figures Donald Rumsfeld and Dick Cheney.

"I read the Cheney family's Trump derangement syndrome as an attempt to buy favor with the [International Criminal Court] and avoid prosecution. Probably too late,” Thiel said. “And I have come to suspect that the threat of an ICC arrest warrant is the sword of Damocles hanging over the Trump administration as it tries to persecute this war in Iran."

Thiel also discusses meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in early 2024, after the Oct. 7 attack, where he said he asked the leader about his plans in Gaza. Thiel said Netanyahu told him, “I can’t just Dresdenize it,” referring to the Allied bombing of the German city of Dresden during World War II that killed roughly 25,000 people.

The first big tech investor to back Trump in 2016, and then have a high-profile speaking role at the Republican National Convention that year, Thiel was also the biggest financial backer of super PACs supporting Vice President JD Vance’s Senate campaign in 2022. POLITICO reported in March that Vance was “skeptical” of the U.S. striking Iran in the lead-up to the beginning of the war.

Representatives for Thiel and the White House did not respond to requests for comment.

Read more from Thiel’s latest lectures in Thursday’s edition of Decoded by POLITICO, including his sentiments toward Israel and predictions for the 2028 election.

CORRECTION: An earlier version of this report misstated Benjamin Netanyahu's title.This article originally appeared on Politico at https://www.politico.com/news/2026/10/21/peter-thiel-trump-iran-war-01131284

item.title: 分析：美国不付代价的霸权时代终结，源自全球实力的国内政治基础正在瓦解
item.description:
美国的全球实力已经脱离了国内政治基础。 造成这种局面的主要原因，并不是特朗普或右翼民粹主义，而是单极世界结束后的国际环境，正在不断考验美国的对外承诺，以及长期以来希望以低廉成本维持外交政策的国内政治共识。 即使特朗普及其政治运动一夜之间全部消失，这个问题仍将继续存在。 但从某种意义上说，问题也没有许多人认为的那么根深蒂固。 美国并没有背弃1945年以后建立的国际秩序。 美国真正试图改变的，是1989年以后形成的国际安排，以及支撑这些安排的国内政治默契。 这种默契如今已经无法继续维持。 本文并不打算为美国未来应该选择哪条道路开出政策处方，但确实要对一种颇具诱惑力的方向提出警告：试图重新回到一个美国领导人宣称愿意为自由付出一切的时代。 正如约翰·肯尼迪当年那段慷慨激昂的宣言：“为了确保自由的生存与成功，我们愿意付出任何代价，承担任何重担，忍受任何艰难，支持任何朋友，反对任何敌人。” 但那是一个不同的世界。 即使在那个时代，美国也希望自己付出的代价是合理的，承担的重担是值得的。

item.title: Oregon teacher says she played dead after being shot in elementary school attack
item.description:
A teacher who was shot by a teenage gunman in a Bend, Oregon, elementary school last week said she saw the attacker and tried to shut the classroom door, “but the shooter was already there.”

Becky Drury said she was shot at close range in the rampage at Silver Rail Elementary School on Thursday.

“Lying on the floor, I saw that my left hand was almost completely severed from the gunshot, and my other arm was also severely injured,” Drury said in a statement Wednesday.

“I could not get up, defend myself, or protect anyone else,” she said. “So, I did the only thing I could do, which was to pretend to be dead in the hope he would not shoot me again.”

Three children, ages 5, 8 and 11, and a 25-year-old teacher were killed in the attack, which began around 1 p.m., officials said.

The gunman was fatally shot by a bystander who saw him fire at a truck and enter the school, police have said. The bystander followed the 16-year-old gunman and shot him as another teacher was wrestling with him over the weapon, according to police.

The motive remained under investigation Wednesday.

Investigators are looking into whether the shooter viewed any extremist material online, including material associated with “nihilistic violent extremism,” also known as NVE, two senior law enforcement officials briefed on the investigation told NBC News.

The gun was purchased legally, Bend police said in a statement Wednesday.

Police have said that it was a Maverick 88 pump-action 12-gauge shotgun and that the shooter used birdshot, buckshot and slugs.

Police have not said who purchased the gun. Two senior law enforcement officials previously told NBC News that the shooter’s mother bought it in August, around the time of his birthday.

“Bend Police detectives continue this complex investigation. They have served search warrants at the shooting suspect’s home, as well as on his electronic devices and his social media accounts on a variety of platforms,” police said in a statement Wednesday.

“That work continues, and it takes time,” the police department said.

Students in the greater Bend-La Pine Schools district returned to class Wednesday, although not at Silver Rail Elementary, where the shooting occurred.

“Through heartfelt artwork and messages of love, they are making sure every student who walks through the doors knows they are cared for, supported and loved,” the district said Tuesday as it prepared to welcome most students back.

Authorities have publicly identified two of the victims who were killed, 5-year-old Rhoam Summer and teacher Megan Lambert.

Drury, the wounded teacher, said in her statement that she heard a noise last week and went to investigate.

“Here is what I remember: Once I realized something was happening outside, I ran to see what was going on,” she said.

“I then saw the shooter and immediately ran back into the classroom. I turned to shut the door behind me, but the shooter was already there,” she said.

Drury said that there was nothing more she could have done and that “I was shot before I had any chance to act.”

“What happened in that classroom was unimaginable, and like so many in this community, my heart is broken for everyone affected by this tragedy,” she said.

“My thoughts are with those who were hurt, those we lost, their families, our school, and the Bend community,” she said. “I am truly grateful for the kindness and support we have received as we face the difficult days ahead together.”

This article was originally published on NBCNews.com

This article originally appeared on NBC News at https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/teacher-survived-bend-shooting-tried-close-door-shooter-was-already-rcna604904

item.title: 日经新闻：在俄罗斯和日本的领土争端中，习近平准备无视毛泽东对日本的承诺
item.description:
中国代表团此次登岛，正值东京与北京因日本首相高市早苗有关台湾可能发生紧急事态的争议性言论而陷入长期外交紧张关系之际。 去年11月，高市早苗在日本国会表示，如果中国可能对台湾发动攻击，就可能构成威胁日本生存的事态，从而允许日本行使集体自卫权。 中国认为台湾是中国领土的一部分，并不排除在必要时使用武力实现两岸统一。 习近平政府目前尚未正式撤回中国在日俄长期领土争端中对日本的支持，但已经非常接近这一步。 一个没有明说的威胁，正笼罩着日本周边海域：中国可能彻底推翻长期以来支持日本对北方领土拥有主权的立场。 可以把黑龙江省代表团此次访问，看作习近平政府向高市早苗政府发出的警告：习近平政府已经准备好采取行动，兑现放弃毛泽东时代对日政策的威胁。

item.title: 大西洋月刊：特朗普主义账单终于到来，再次提醒人们不要轻信他在金钱方面作出的保证
item.description:
截至9月30日的财政年度，美国联邦财政赤字约为2万亿美元，比拜登担任总统期间最后一个完整财政年度增加约1600亿美元。 明年的财政赤字很可能进一步扩大。 特朗普当初谈论消除国债时，美国联邦债务总额接近35万亿美元。按照目前的发展趋势，到2028年，这个数字可能达到45万亿美元。 换一种方式来看： 2008年金融危机期间，美国国债总额首次达到10万亿美元。当时，这个数字已经被视为难以承受的沉重负担。 如今，仅仅特朗普四年不负责任的财政政策，就可能让美国再增加10万亿美元债务。

item.description:

item.title: 一支世界杯冠军球队与它的清华“教练”
item.description:
2026-10-22 09:00:00

“你要做繁荣的推动者，而不是等它繁荣了，再跑来借势。”赵明国对南方周末说。

赵明国是清华大学自动化系研究员、机器人控制实验室主任。他长得又高又瘦，留着板寸头，戴着方框眼镜。他在2003年留校任教，一手组建并带大了“清华大学火神队”。这支队伍自2004年起参加机器人世界杯（Robot World Cup），最近两年连续卫冕类人组冠军。

这支队伍累计的一百多名学生队员，现在都成了中国具身智能领域的弄潮儿。其中，程昊创办的公司加速进化甚至改写了机器人世界杯比赛规则，它的机器人成为官方标准平台，被八成参赛队伍使用。

以机器人为代表的具身智能，眼下正在迎来最好的发展年代。在这之前，赵明国和火神队坐了二十多年的“冷板凳”。他淡淡地说，“既没有经济的窘迫，技术上也没有遭遇‘被堵死’的局面，它只是发展得慢而已。”

从象棋盘到足球场

“深蓝”赢下国际象棋冠军后，科学家们认为，人工智能面临的下一个问题是踢足球，机器人世界杯由此诞生。2004年清华大学火神队组建时，日本站在人形机器人研究与赛事的中心，中国不过是个“初来乍到”的边缘角色。

1996年，在计算机“深蓝”与国际象棋冠军加里·卡斯帕罗夫的首次对弈中，人类险胜。同年，另一场竞赛也在紧密筹备中，机器人世界杯国际联合会成立。科学家们认为，象棋的问题一旦解决，AI下一个要征服的应当是足球。

1997年，卡斯帕罗夫认输,“深蓝”以3.5比2.5赢下人机大战。三个多月后，首届机器人世界杯在日本名古屋举行。

加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚大学教授艾伦·马克沃斯（Alan Mackworth）在1992年最早提出，将足球赛作为人工智能和机器人学科的共同标准难题，因为它将机器人需要的诸多复合能力都囊括了进来——感知、决策、控制、交互、协作以及对高动态、不确定性环境的实时反馈，这些能力在日后都可以向其他行业应用迁移。

这一想法迅速在日本落地，1993年东京发起了一项比赛Robot J-League，它随后被扩展为一个国际项目，改称机器人世界杯。该赛事诞生后的短短几年间，世界最知名的公司如索尼、微软、三星、库卡机器人、路易威登等都为它提供了赞助。

这一时期，作为“机器人霸主”的日本还站在这项赛事圈的核心，而中国直到2006年才成为机器人世界杯国际联合会认定的五大国际赛区之一。

在中国，清华大学较早就参与到这项赛事中，计算机系教授孙增圻早在2001年就带领“风神队”参与机器人世界杯并取得冠军，但风神队参加的是仿真组，即让算法在一个完全虚拟的“足球场”上模拟参赛。教会机器人面对充满随机性和不确定性的真实世界显然更难，中国团队在硬件组一直缺席，直到赵明国博士后出站。

赵明国本科与博士均就读于哈尔滨工业大学机械电子工程专业。21世纪初，国内机器人研究刚刚兴起，清华大学设立了一个机器人重大研究项目， 2001年赵明国博士后进校后，便在其中负责控制性能。

这个项目缔造了中国第一台仿人机器人THBIP-I，身高1.72米、体重130公斤，初具“规划-协调-执行”三层大小脑雏形，但它一小时只能走几十米。而同一时期的日本ASIMO已经开始攻克动态奔跑和复杂的全身运动，跑步速度达到6公里/小时。

2003年，赵明国博士后出站便留校任教。清华大学自动化系希望从教学角度切入，将学生培养与课题研究串起来。赵明国很快就想到了机器人世界杯——作为国际比赛，其规格高、影响广，对学生来说是难得的锻炼。

那时，机器人还是一个冷门的方向，它周期长、出成果慢，赵明国从自动化系的机器人控制实验室抽调了几名学生，自动化系其他老师也各派了一些研究生，凑齐了能上场的阵容。

队伍总得有个名字，赵明国想到了希腊神话中的“火神”赫菲斯托斯——众神的工匠，司掌火焰和工具锻造，与他们“造机器人”这件事十分贴切。因此，队伍被命名为“火神队”。

校委会给他们批了一笔经费，从日本买回来16台索尼AIBO机器狗。今天，宇树Go2机器狗入门款价格只有几千元。但当年，一台AIBO折合人民币大约1.5万元。

就这样，兵马钱粮齐备，赵明国与他的火神队踏上了这条后来走了二十多年的长路。

“棋差一招”的二十年

赵明国要求火神队每年动手搭一套机器人，以磨炼对硬件的认知。但经费拮据，加上当时中国全无供应链的概念，困难重重。学生们艰难摸索，从2008年到2024年，火神队在机器人世界杯上从未出过前三，但也从未拿过第一。

火神队最初参加机器人世界杯，选的是“对新手友好”的四足组，参赛团队统一使用AIBO，只用写程序，不必自己造硬件。根据规则，前三名必须公开代码，相当于今天的开源。

2004年，火神队首秀机器人世界杯国内选拔赛，拿下了四足组冠军。可在次年的国际比赛上，他们只艰难挤进了16强。2006年，火神队在足球项目上的成绩仍不理想，但在机器人世界杯12米竞速走挑战赛里，他们拿到了第一名。

这一步态算法出自队内早期骨干张楫之手，它不靠人预设固定轨迹，而是把运动轨迹参数化，用遗传算法自动搜索最优步伐。后来，张楫赴美国卡内基梅隆大学深造，提出了著名的LOAM算法，后者被视为实时三维激光SLAM的奠基之作，在很长一段时间里高居国际评测榜首。

参加过两届四足组比赛后，赵明国将目光转向了类人组，人形机器人与他的研究方向更契合，火神队大部分成员都来自机械系和自动化系，对做硬件也跃跃欲试。

在机器人世界杯的所有组别中，类人组的规格也最高：它的颁奖仪式是整场赛事的压轴环节，总冠军可以捧走一只“LV杯”（2002-2016年类人组由路易威登赞助），将它保留一年，第二年再传给新的冠军，像世界杯的大力神杯一样。

类人组又按机器人的个头分成三档：KidSize、TeenSize、AdultSize。2007年，火神队第一次踏进类人组，选择的是其中的TeenSize，但依旧没能进8强。

转折发生在2008年。赵明国提出了一套“虚拟斜坡”算法。

人类走路并不会将每一步都提前规划好，受此启发，学界出现了“被动行走”理论，即不主动驱动每一个关节，而是借助重力、惯性和机械结构本身的动力学，“顺”着往前走。相比主动行走，被动行走更稳定和高能效。

赵明国正是被动行走的专家。他将被动动力学的原理与主动控制糅在一起，让机器人在平地上也像踩着一个看不见的缓坡往下走，借势前行。在实验室的Stepper2D样机上，他们跑出了每秒4.48个腿长的速度，逼近人类竞走运动员的水平。

科研突破很快兑现成赛场名次。2008年火神队杀进了决赛，最终惜败于日本大阪队，拿到亚军。这是中国团队在机器人世界杯类人组第一次名列三甲。

也是从做人形起，火神队开始自己做硬件，他们每年都会将机器人的结构重新设计、组装一遍，而不是沿用上一年的机器人。在赵明国看来，自己设计的硬件，才最适配自己写的算法。

但麻烦的是，人形机器人的关键部件比如舵机还要从外国进口。那几年火神队经费拮据，靠学院、校友等多方资金支撑着。有一年，赵明国的朋友从日本给他寄来了四十个舵机，这件事，他记到现在。

硬件能力跟上后，2010年，火神队成为国内高校里唯一能搭出AdultSize机器人的队伍。次年，他们从TeenSize组转战AdultSize组，首次参赛便获得了该组别第三名。

在早期比赛中，机器人的视觉识别存在很大短板，足球一旦被其他物体稍稍遮挡，机器人便会因为找不到球而突然停滞在原地。

这个问题被当时计算机系的一名大一学生徐持衡解决了。在清华期间，徐持衡集齐了国际大学生程序设计竞赛亚洲区域赛的金、银、铜牌，还曾作为清华超算队的队长拿下亚洲大学生超算竞赛总冠军。他花两周时间写出一套算法，让机器人在球被遮住大部分时也能将之辨认出来。

在火神队期间，徐持衡负责机器人决策，另一名物理系的学生李诚负责定位，运动控制则由自动化系的学生负责。后来，徐持衡又把同班同学陈宇恒也拉进了进来。他们三人在队期间，为火神队吸引了一批背景偏“软”的成员。

接下来的2012年机器人世界杯，由李诚带队，这是火神队离冠军最近的一次。在小组赛中，火神队以4比1战胜了美国的Team CHARLI，可到了决赛，由于轴承出现故障，他们的机器人忽然无法正常走路，最终以3比0输给了Team CHARLI，只拿到亚军。

两年后的机器人世界杯，火神队再度遭遇意外。

赵明国从日本订购的电机迟迟不到货，新机器无法完工，他们只能拖出前一年的旧机器人上场，而旧机器人在发热、关节方面都有很大的问题。为了省机票钱，队长候一凡带着几名学生选择了最便宜的多次转机路线，从北京辗转60个小时才抵达比赛地巴西。落地后，他们靠酒店免费的自助早餐度日，将早餐时顺的几个面包当作午饭。

侯一凡主攻运动控制，为这一战开发了一套新算法，让机器人能稳定地单脚站立，另一脚以最大力度踢球。这支撑火神队在捉襟见肘的条件下拿到了第三名。

后来，候一凡前往卡内基梅隆大学深造，研究方向拓展到机器人操作，后来又加入亚马逊机器人部门任应用科学家。黄青虬继任队长。

AI浪潮袭来

2012年后，AI浪潮涌来，在人脸识别、自动驾驶、人形机器人等领域，一批先驱公司喷薄欲出，在它们生命初期，核心团队中都曾有赵明国和火神队的身影。

2012年，辛顿用一套神经网络AlexNet在ImageNet图像识别大赛上拿下第一，深度学习复兴，重新进入科研的聚光灯下，一批明星AI公司也从那时起开始萌芽。

徐持衡继续沿着视觉的路线探索，参加完2012机器人世界杯后，便去了香港中文大学多媒体实验室（MMLab）实习，深得实验室创始人汤晓鸥看重。次年年初，汤晓鸥创业，徐持衡作为联合创始人，还拉上了李诚、陈宇恒，三人成为商汤001、002和003号员工。他们在清华大学门口的文津酒店公寓租了一间房，开启了创业苦旅。清华大学机器人控制实验室的部分学生也参与其中。

不久后，他们开发出一个名为DeepID的模型，该模型在人脸识别评测LFW上取得了99.15%的识别率，一举超越Facebook，商汤一战成名。

紧随其后，AI很快就从二维的屏幕里溢出来，去真实世界寻找一具物理的身体。

在中国，最早下场的是百度。2013年，百度成立深度学习研究院（IDL），这里后来被奉为中国自动驾驶的“黄埔军校”。当时百度高层认为，中国是自行车第一大国，因此，在做自动驾驶汽车之前，他们先做了另一件小事——自动驾驶自行车。

这个项目的执行负责人恰好曾是清华大学自动化系的本科生，名叫倪凯，也就是日后禾多科技的创始人。在寻找合作团队时，他自然而然想到了赵明国。后者带队设计了硬件架构，2014年机器就位，赵明国记得那年是个暖冬，他们常趁着中午操场没人时跑出去做实验。

2014年年底，项目如期交付。百度后来把一台自行车留给了赵明国。他带着学生又打磨了一年，让它学会了自主导航和平衡，时速达到20km。赵明国给这辆车取名“佐罗的马”——在电影《佐罗》中，佐罗一声令下，他的爱马便会疾速奔驰，前来相助。

这些项目的积累，叠加当年AI学科的快速发展，赵明国觉得，机器人研究突然顺起来了，“当时以为是自己开窍了，但现在回看，是时代变了。”

汽车之后，AI的风终于吹到了机器人身上。

2015年，日后的“人形机器人第一股”优必选刚刚开始启动全尺寸人形机器人研发，而赵明国团队是国内为数不多有这方面能力的团队之一。2015年，优必选联合创始人熊友军找到赵明国，双方敲定了合作。次年，优必选在北京设立研究所，由赵明国出任所长、首席科学家；火神队2008年的队长董浩也加入了优必选，主导组建了Walker机器人运控核心团队。

那几年，优必选正是资本市场的宠儿，融资一笔接着一笔，几乎每笔都是亿元级。在财大气粗的优必选的赞助下，火神队过上了一段不缺钱的日子。

优必选派遣了工程师与赵明国团队联合研发。2018年1月，优必选发布了第一代Walker机器人，2017-2019年，火神队参加Robocup的机器人都是用Walker改装的，赛场上的验证结果又会被优必选拿走，作为迭代的参考。2019年1月，优必选又快速拿出了第二代Walker，将全身关节的数量从14个升级到36个，机器人也从仅能行走、上下楼梯到可以完成开冰箱、取物品等手眼协调的操作。

随后的三年新冠疫情期间，火神队停赛，优必选也遭遇了资本寒冬，合作按下暂停键。疫情过后，火神队队员创办了人形机器人公司加速进化，优必选的机器人也扭头走向了工厂，双方就此在岔路口分别。

散作满天星

火神队历届队员共百余人，其中有许多今天这波创业潮里熟悉的名字，程昊、徐持衡、黄青虬……其中，加速进化的机器人已成为Robocup的标准平台，中国从边缘参赛者，逐渐走到了定义规则的位置。

2022年，特斯拉机器人Optimus全球首秀，具身智能创业潮开始暗流涌动。根据IT桔子的数据，2024年至2026年上半年，相关融资事件达650起，总金额超1400亿元，数百家新公司挤进赛道。

火神队2010年的队长程昊也在此时回到学校，与赵明国商量创业的事。毕业后他曾短暂地在亚马逊负责AI方面的研发，后来创立了游戏研发与分发公司朝夕光年，并被字节收购。

他们商讨了几个月，最后还是决定回到“老本行”——机器人本体和运动控制。2023年6月，加速进化正式成立，程昊出任CEO，赵明国任首席科学家，火神队不少老队员都在这家公司重新聚首，董浩也离开优必选加入，目前任研发副总裁。

在一个“大脑”越来越性感的年代，加速进化反倒选择了“小脑”。

“先留在牌桌上，才能谈以后。”赵明国认为，具身大模型技术路线还没收敛，一家初创小公司现在扑上去，没有太大优势，不如先把本体做扎实。等未来把营收盘推上亿元级，站稳了脚跟，再去开辟“大脑”这一“第二曲线”也不迟。

这条路跟宇树有些相似，两者都盯上了教育市场。不同的是，加速进化的切口更小，它的第一个目标，是为机器人世界杯打造一个新平台。

在类人组之外，机器人世界杯还设有一个“标准平台组”（前身为四足组），即参赛队伍统一使用指定硬件，只比拼算法。早期，标准平台组的指定硬件是索尼AIBO，AIBO停产后，2008年标准平台更换为法国公司Aldebaran的NAO机器人，其间Aldebaran颠沛流离，几经软银、德国URG转手，一度破产清算，后来又被中国公司盛视科技收购，NAO几乎近十年未再更新，硬件因跟不上AI开发而备受诟病。

与此同时，赛事规则也在震荡。机器人世界杯联合创始人及前主席、卡内基梅隆大学教授Manuela Veloso甚至提出，由官方拉赞助，筹集一批机器人再启动，后续赛事完全转向人形机器人。

机器人世界杯组委会争执不休。赵明国索性决定“另起炉灶”，由自己制定规则，于是就有了2025年6月北京的RoBoLeague。在这场赛事中，火神队获得了冠军。在同年的机器人世界杯与世界人形机器人运动会上，火神队同样揽得魁首。

此后，加速进化的硬件立刻以“一边倒”的优势得到了机器人世界杯组委会的支持，进入官方推荐机型。2026年，机器人世界杯将标准平台组与类人组合并，加速进化的机器人成为新的标准平台。比赛还推出了“机器人池”计划，向资源不足的参赛团队出借硬件，加速进化是这一计划的直接赞助者。这一年，约八成参赛队伍使用的都是加速进化的机器人。

赛事催化了加速进化的订单，到2026年9月，其人形机器人出货量破3000台，同比倍增。

除了程昊和加速进化，这波创业潮里与火神队相关的名字还有很多：

黄青虬曾以华为“天才少年”的身份加入并主导了华为ADS 1.0至4.0的算法迭代，2025年年底离职后创立了具身智能公司墨奇智能；张楫加入芝诺机器人，出任首席机器人架构师；徐持衡在商汤攒下“第一桶金”后，先是进入机器人操作系统公司灵宇宙任CTO，如今又创办了陪伴类具身智能公司酷奇奇。


迟到的“捧杯”

赵明国认为，“科研成果会把团队拉上新的台阶，然后从这里再长出新的任务，如此循环下去。”新一代队员的名字开始出现在论文中，王与时、陈蓬辉……谁也不知道，未来他们中会不会走出下一个商汤或者加速进化。

2025年7月20日，火神队拿下了RoboCup类人组Adult Size的冠军。

赵明国很平静，观战时，他就料到了结果。

在这场比赛中，火神队使用了一套“大力射门”算法（HumanoidKick），让机器人像人一样用足弓推球，脚内侧接触球的面积更大，力的传递更稳定。在此之前，机器人射门多是生硬地把球“捅”出去。这套算法由赵明国的研究生王与时主导开发，字节跳动的Seed团队也参与其中。

一个月后世界人形机器人运动会的足球赛，决赛最后的那记致胜之球，也是基于这套技术。得益于此，火神队击败了劲敌德国队。德国队由莱比锡应用技术大学HTWK Robots与多特蒙德工业大学Nao Devils组成，这两支队伍曾是多届RoboCup的冠军得主。

最近两年，RoboCup类人组AdultSize的亚军与季军也均被中国高校包揽，分别是中国农业大学的山海队、北京信息科技大学的Water队。

回头看，从2008年首次进入三甲到2025年夺冠，火神队每次的名次进阶都与算法突破有着密切关系。这些反馈强化了赵明国的认知，火神队逐渐从以教学为主转向以科研为主。

目前，火神队的人才培养已被纳入自动化系的选修课体系中，队员除了赵明国自己的研究生外，主要从大二、大三学生中选拔。清华大学机器人社团也是校内第一大社团和最佳社团，同样由赵明国主管，火神算是其中的主力。

回顾过去三十年，机器人世界杯日益向人类世界杯靠拢。

最早的RoboCup只有“点球”，那时候，一台机器人能站在原地将球踢出去已经是很了不起的事。2005年，类人组首次举办了正式的2v2对抗赛，此后2v2又升级为3v3甚至5v5，并逐渐引入更多国际足联（FIFA）的规则，比如任意球、越位、犯规。2006年起，比赛开始明确要求机器人完全自主，严禁任何形式的外部电源和遥控。2025年，比赛取消了跟在机器人身后的保护员handler，彻底移除了人类干预。

相应地，技术挑战也越来越高，这主要包含三重难关。

第一关是机器人对自己身体的控制。机器人常被“队友”绊倒，“摔倒后快速起身”是一大难点。火神队2025年队长陈蓬辉的研究方向就是“敏捷运动恢复”，他借助强化学习的范式，让机器人在相对标准的跌倒姿态下，在两秒内就能重新站起，在过去，同样的动作要耗费将近十秒。

第二关，机器人要在满场的人影与腿脚之间找到足球，场地变大、机器人运动速度变快都给视觉处理带来了更大的挑战。在2025年的世界人形机器人运动会上，一台机器人误将球场边广告牌上某赞助商的圆形logo当成了足球，一脚踹上去，在广告牌上留下了一个大洞。

比“看见球”更难的是“接住球”，足球的滚动带有很强的随机性。

“赛场上很难见到机器人一脚踢中滚动的球，即便有也是误打误撞。”赵明国解释，此前通用的办法是做“连线题”，即机器人先跑到球附近，站到球与球门连线的延长线上，再朝着球门踢球。从观众的视角看，机器人在球边犹犹豫豫、反复调整，其实就是在对准球门。

为了解决这个问题，火神队用一套端到端的算法，让机器人不必反复思考即可做出动作。这项研究认为，人类踢球是一种“直觉式”的动作，而非经过显式的计算和规划，因此，他们先让机器人在仿真里做大量的训练形成某种“本能”，将视觉感知与动作控制耦合起来，“就好比学习一件事需要花费很大的精力，但考试时只需要快速调用即可。”

此外，机器人已能够做出拦球、传球、高球等动作，但更精细的“带球过人”仍然无法做到，因为脚下是机器人的视觉盲区，它仍然缺乏“脚感”。

第三关，机器人需要与队友分工配合。

如果同队的机器人共用同一套策略，它们看到球后便会做出同样的行为，将队友全部视为障碍物，导致几台机器人扎堆围在一处，相互干扰。火神队会在算法中写入不同规则，给机器人进行简单的角色划分。但这些固定规则与人类球员那种随机应变的配合还有着不短的距离。

RoboCup的目标是：到2050年，组建一支完全自主的人形机器人足球队，按照国际足联的规则，战胜人类的世界杯冠军。

按照赵明国的判断，技术每五年就可能迎来一次大跨越，以这样的迭代速度计算，在那个“最后期限”到来之前，机器人还剩下四五次跨越的机会。

item.title: 简讯：韩国央行维持基准利率3%不变
item.description: 韩联社首尔10月22日电 韩国银行（央行）22日召开金融货币委员会会议，决定将基准利率维持在3%不变。

item.title: 中国拟出台新规，加强对先进人工智能模型出口管控
item.description:
DAVID PIERSON, ADAM SATARIANO
2026年10月22日

When the Chinese start-up Moonshot AI in July released Kimi K3, an artificial intelligence model that rivaled some of the best systems made by American companies, it was free for anyone to download.

今年7月，当中国初创企业月之暗面发布人工智能模型Kimi K3时，该模型可供任何人免费下载；其性能已足以与美国公司开发的高水平系统相媲美。

By making advanced A.I. models easily available, Chinese companies have turned open access into one of China’s most powerful advantages in its rivalry with the United States to shape the future of the technology.

通过推动先进人工智能模型的便捷普及，中国企业已将开放获取打造为中国与美国争夺该技术未来主导权时的核心竞争优势之一。

Now Beijing is moving to tighten its grip on the global spread of the country’s top-tier A.I., proposing rules that could give the government new power to track, and potentially limit, where the systems go.

如今，北京正采取措施加强对本国顶尖人工智能全球传播的管控，拟议中的新规或将赋予政府跟踪乃至限制这些系统去向的新权力。

At the same time, the government sought to reassure users that the move would not stifle access to Chinese A.I., saying the vast majority of the technology would still be freely exported.

与此同时，政府也试图向用户澄清，此举并非要阻碍对中国人工智能的使用，并表示绝大多数技术仍可自由出口。

The draft rules reflect Beijing’s effort to balance two competing goals: regulate the spread of its frontier A.I. systems for strategic and security reasons while still encouraging global users to adopt Chinese software.

规则草案折射出北京在平衡两大相互竞争的目标：一方面出于战略与安全考量监管前沿人工智能系统的传播，另一方面仍鼓励全球用户采用中国软件。

“It is almost like you have two voices speaking at the same time,” said Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution focusing on Chinese technology and industrial policy. “One saying, ‘We want extra control of these sensitive technologies so that they can’t hurt China’ and another voice saying, ‘We want to develop the best A.I. technology and we want to share it with rest of the world.’”

布鲁金斯学会关注中国科技与产业政策的研究员陈凯欣(Kyle Chan)表示：“这几乎就像有两个声音在同时发声：一个声音说‘我们需要对这些敏感技术实施额外管控，以免危害中国’；另一个声音则说‘我们要开发最顶尖的人工智能技术，并与世界共享’。”

今年7月在上海举行的人工智能大会上，中国人工智能初创公司月之暗面为其模型Kimi设立的展台。Kimi K3可与美国公司打造的一些最佳系统相媲美。

China’s Ministry of Commerce’s announcement of the draft rules last Friday threw uncertainty into an A.I. market that has come to see the availability of free Chinese A.I. models from companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, Z.ai and Moonshot as an important alternative to services from American companies such as Anthropic and OpenAI.

上周五，中国商务部发布规则草案公告，给当前的人工智能市场蒙上了不确定性。此前，市场已逐渐将阿里巴巴、DeepSeek、智谱及月之暗面等公司提供的免费中国人工智能模型视为替代Anthropic和OpenAI等美国公司服务的重要选择。

The ministry said the rules would not affect Chinese models that have already been released, and overseas users could still access even the most advanced systems through apps and online services.

商务部表示，新规不会影响此前已发布的中国模型，海外用户未来仍可通过应用程序及在线服务使用包括最先进系统在内的各类模型。

The Risks China Wants to Contain

中国拟遏制的风险

If passed, the rules would require Chinese companies to obtain licenses to export the core technology behind their leading models.

一旦通过，这些规则将要求中国企业在出口其领先模型背后的核心技术时必须取得许可。

They would also ban the export of A.I. that can be used to launch cyberattacks, as well as models trained on what China calls “core data.” The government broadly defines that as data that concerns national security, the welfare of Chinese citizens and the public interest. Experts say the scope includes data on the military or critical infrastructure, state secrets and other sensitive information.

新规还将禁止出口可用于发起网络攻击的人工智能，以及基于中国所称“核心数据”训练出的模型。中国政府将“核心数据”广泛定义为涉及国家安全、中国公民福祉及社会公共利益的数据。专家指出，这一范围涵盖军事或关键基础设施、国家秘密及其他敏感信息相关数据。

The commerce ministry said the new controls were necessary to guard against abuse and malicious use and to ensure that A.I. always remains under human control.

商务部指出，出台新的管控措施对于防范技术滥用和恶用、确保人工智能始终处于人类掌控之下是必要的。

The power of A.I. systems to escape their creators’ control and hack into real-world systems without human knowledge has drawn global scrutiny. In the United States, A.I. agents being tested by OpenAI broke into outside systems including the A.I. start-up Hugging Face, and meddled with U.S. government websites. The agents also hacked into an Australian government website and acquired health data, prompting an investigation by Australian officials.

人工智能系统摆脱开发者控制并在人类不知情下入侵现实世界系统的能力已引发全球关注。在美国，OpenAI测试的AI智能体曾入侵外部系统（包括人工智能初创公司Hugging Face），并擅闯美国政府网站。此外，相关智能体还入侵了澳大利亚政府网站并获取了健康数据，引发澳大利亚官方调查。

In China, the internet giant Tencent last week acknowledged that A.I. agents it used to evaluate other companies’ models had behaved in ways it did not intend, after researchers said the agents tried to bypass anti-robot protections on websites.

在中国，研究人员指出互联网巨头腾讯用于评估其他公司模型的AI智能体试图绕过网站的反爬虫保护后，腾讯于上周承认，这些智能体的行为确实超出了设计初衷。

China’s proposed export rules signaled that the government is concerned about the safety of increasingly sophisticated A.I. models, as calls have grown for the United States and China to prevent the technology from causing catastrophic harm. Earlier this month, the Communist Party’s Central Committee and the State Council, China’s cabinet, called for the establishment of a monitoring and emergency response system that would ensure that A.I. is “safe, reliable and controllable.”

在中美两国防范人工智能引发灾难性危害的呼声日益高涨之际，中国拟议的出口规则表明官方对日益复杂的人工智能模型的安全性心存担忧。本月早些时候，中共中央、国务院要求建立监测与应急响应体系，确保人工智能“安全、可靠、可控”。

“These controls show that China is taking the risks of powerful A.I. much more seriously than was generally understood,” said Martin Chorzempa, senior fellow at the Peterson Institute for International Economics.

彼得森国际经济研究所高级研究员马丁·肖尔赞帕表示：“这些管控举措表明，中国对待强大人工智能风险的严肃程度远超外界普遍预期。”

What the Rules Could Change

新规可能带来的改变

Still, much remains unclear, such as how strictly China will enforce the rules and how burdensome the licensing process will be, especially for labs that release updates to their models every few weeks.

不过，目前仍有许多细节尚不明确，例如中国执行这些规则的严厉程度，以及相关许可流程的繁琐程度——特别是对于每隔数周即更新发布一次模型的实验室而言。

One of the draft rules called for export restrictions on any “globally leading” model, which the ministry said could be partly defined as a system that ranks in the top 10 for global usage. It also set thresholds for a model’s size and how much computation was used in its training. Meeting any one of those criteria would be enough to require a license.

规则草案提及，将对所有“全球领先”的模型实施出口限制。商务部表示，其衡量标准之一包括在全球使用量中排名前十的系统。草案还对模型的参数规模及训练计算量设定了门槛，满足上述任意一项标准即需申请许可。

Analysts at Trivium China, a research and advisory firm, wrote in a note to clients that the criteria would capture future versions of Kimi, Qwen, and DeepSeek, referring to three of the most advanced Chinese models.

策纬咨询(Trivium China)分析师在一份面向客户的报告中写道，这些标准将覆盖Kimi、通义千问和DeepSeek等三大中国顶尖模型的未来迭代版本。

通义千问是中国科技巨头阿里巴巴于2023年启动的人工智能模型系列。阿里巴巴将其最受欢迎的人工智能模型开源，允许他人免费使用和修改。

If adopted, the rules would also give Beijing a say over who buys Chinese A.I. companies.

一旦通过，这些规则还将赋予北京对中国人工智能企业收购案的审批决策权。

That could close the regulatory loophole that briefly allowed Meta to acquire Manus, a Singapore-based A.I. company that was founded in China, earlier this year. Beijing ultimately scuttled the deal, and in an apparent effort to discourage Chinese A.I. executives from moving businesses offshore, restricted Manus executives from leaving China.

这可能堵住今年早些时候一度让Meta得以收购Manus的监管漏洞。Manus是一家在中国创立、总部位于新加坡的人工智能公司。北京最终阻止了这笔交易，并限制Manus高管离境，以此警告中国人工智能高管切勿将业务转移至海外。

No Longer Fully Open?

不再完全开放？

Many Chinese models are open-weight, which means they are available for other developers to download and customize as they see fit. That contrasts with services like ChatGPT or Claude, which only offer access through a subscription and cannot be modified.

许多中国模型属开放权重模型，这意味着其他开发者可以随意下载并根据自身需求进行定制。这与ChatGPT或Claude等仅限付费订阅且无法被修改的服务形成了鲜明对比。

Once downloaded, a Chinese model could be run on a company’s own computers indefinitely, beyond the reach of anyone who might want to restrict it. Users of American A.I., on the other hand, are essentially renting access that can be taken away. That was the case in June when the Trump administration temporarily restricted foreign access to Anthropic’s Fable 5 model, citing national security risks.

中国模型一旦下载，即可在企业自身的计算机上无限期运行，不受任何后续限制措施的影响。相比之下，美国人工智能的用户本质上只是租用使用权，这种权限随时可能被剥夺。例如今年6月，特朗普政府就曾以国家安全风险为由，临时限制外部获取Anthropic的Fable 5模型。

Now companies outside China that rely on Chinese A.I. systems could face similar risks.

如今，中国以外依赖中国人工智能系统的企业也可能面临类似的风险。

“This could make U.S. businesses more hesitant to rely on Chinese models going forward,” said Chris McGuire, a senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations.

美国外交关系协会高级研究员克里斯·麦奎尔表示：“这可能会使美国企业在未来对依赖中国模型持更加审慎的态度。”

A.I. has emerged as a point of geopolitical tension between Washington and Beijing, with U.S. agencies accusing DeepSeek and other Chinese A.I. companies of industrial-scale copying. On Monday, the Department of Homeland Security ordered the removal of DeepSeek’s tools from the technological systems of many U.S. government agencies, which China described as an act of discrimination.

人工智能已成为华盛顿与北京地缘政治摩擦的焦点之一，美国相关部门指责DeepSeek等中国人工智能企业进行工业级抄袭。周一，美国国土安全部下令在多个政府机构的技术系统中全面停用DeepSeek的工具，对此中国指责是歧视性做法。

A.I. as a Tool of Influence

人工智能作为软实力工具

Beijing, however, has also couched the controls in the language of international cooperation, in a nod to the soft power influence of its A.I. technology.

然而，北京也将相关管控置于国际合作的语境下，以此彰显其人工智能技术的软实力影响。

北京的一处DeepSeek标志。DeepSeek的开源模型是中国实现成为人工智能超级大国雄心壮志的核心。

The government pledged to help narrow the digital divide in the world, particularly by supporting developing countries that are members of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, a group that China founded in July that includes Indonesia, Pakistan and Brazil.

中国政府承诺帮助缩小全球数字鸿沟，特别是加大对世界人工智能合作组织成员国中发展中国家的支持力度。该组织由中国于今年7月发起成立，成员包括印度尼西亚、巴基斯坦和巴西等国。

“That’s potentially quite noteworthy,” said Julian Gewirtz, a former China director for the National Security Council in the Biden administration now a scholar at Columbia University. “Beijing is establishing controls while suggesting it would offer favorable treatment for cooperation through a China-backed institution.”

曾任拜登政府国家安全委员会中国事务主管、现为哥伦比亚大学学者的朱利安·格维兹指出：“这在潜在层面相当值得关注。北京在确立管控的同时表明，它会通过一个中国支持的机制，为愿意合作的各方提供特惠待遇。”

郭莉莉(Lily Kuo)和Berry Wang对本文有报道贡献。

David Pierson报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。

Adam Satariano是时报科技记者，常驻伦敦。

翻译：纽约时报中文网

点击查看本文英文版。

今年7月在上海举行的人工智能大会上，中国人工智能初创公司月之暗面为其模型Kimi设立的展台。Kimi K3可与美国公司打造的一些最佳系统相媲美。

上周五，中国商务部发布规则草案公告，给当前的人工智能市场蒙上了不确定性。此前，市场已逐渐将阿里巴巴、DeepSeek、智谱及月之暗面等公司提供的免费中国人工智能模型视为替代Anthropic和OpenAI等美国公司服务的重要选择。

商务部表示，新规不会影响此前已发布的中国模型，海外用户未来仍可通过应用程序及在线服务使用包括最先进系统在内的各类模型。

中国拟遏制的风险

一旦通过，这些规则将要求中国企业在出口其领先模型背后的核心技术时必须取得许可。

新规还将禁止出口可用于发起网络攻击的人工智能，以及基于中国所称“核心数据”训练出的模型。中国政府将“核心数据”广泛定义为涉及国家安全、中国公民福祉及社会公共利益的数据。专家指出，这一范围涵盖军事或关键基础设施、国家秘密及其他敏感信息相关数据。

商务部指出，出台新的管控措施对于防范技术滥用和恶用、确保人工智能始终处于人类掌控之下是必要的。

人工智能系统摆脱开发者控制并在人类不知情下入侵现实世界系统的能力已引发全球关注。在美国，OpenAI测试的AI智能体曾入侵外部系统（包括人工智能初创公司Hugging Face），并擅闯美国政府网站。此外，相关智能体还入侵了澳大利亚政府网站并获取了健康数据，引发澳大利亚官方调查。

在中国，研究人员指出互联网巨头腾讯用于评估其他公司模型的AI智能体试图绕过网站的反爬虫保护后，腾讯于上周承认，这些智能体的行为确实超出了设计初衷。

在中美两国防范人工智能引发灾难性危害的呼声日益高涨之际，中国拟议的出口规则表明官方对日益复杂的人工智能模型的安全性心存担忧。本月早些时候，中共中央、国务院要求建立监测与应急响应体系，确保人工智能“安全、可靠、可控”。

彼得森国际经济研究所高级研究员马丁·肖尔赞帕表示：“这些管控举措表明，中国对待强大人工智能风险的严肃程度远超外界普遍预期。”

新规可能带来的改变

不过，目前仍有许多细节尚不明确，例如中国执行这些规则的严厉程度，以及相关许可流程的繁琐程度——特别是对于每隔数周即更新发布一次模型的实验室而言。

规则草案提及，将对所有“全球领先”的模型实施出口限制。商务部表示，其衡量标准之一包括在全球使用量中排名前十的系统。草案还对模型的参数规模及训练计算量设定了门槛，满足上述任意一项标准即需申请许可。

策纬咨询(Trivium China)分析师在一份面向客户的报告中写道，这些标准将覆盖Kimi、通义千问和DeepSeek等三大中国顶尖模型的未来迭代版本。

通义千问是中国科技巨头阿里巴巴于2023年启动的人工智能模型系列。阿里巴巴将其最受欢迎的人工智能模型开源，允许他人免费使用和修改。

一旦通过，这些规则还将赋予北京对中国人工智能企业收购案的审批决策权。

这可能堵住今年早些时候一度让Meta得以收购Manus的监管漏洞。Manus是一家在中国创立、总部位于新加坡的人工智能公司。北京最终阻止了这笔交易，并限制Manus高管离境，以此警告中国人工智能高管切勿将业务转移至海外。

不再完全开放？

许多中国模型属开放权重模型，这意味着其他开发者可以随意下载并根据自身需求进行定制。这与ChatGPT或Claude等仅限付费订阅且无法被修改的服务形成了鲜明对比。

中国模型一旦下载，即可在企业自身的计算机上无限期运行，不受任何后续限制措施的影响。相比之下，美国人工智能的用户本质上只是租用使用权，这种权限随时可能被剥夺。例如今年6月，特朗普政府就曾以国家安全风险为由，临时限制外部获取Anthropic的Fable 5模型。

如今，中国以外依赖中国人工智能系统的企业也可能面临类似的风险。

美国外交关系协会高级研究员克里斯·麦奎尔表示：“这可能会使美国企业在未来对依赖中国模型持更加审慎的态度。”

人工智能已成为华盛顿与北京地缘政治摩擦的焦点之一，美国相关部门指责DeepSeek等中国人工智能企业进行工业级抄袭。周一，美国国土安全部下令在多个政府机构的技术系统中全面停用DeepSeek的工具，对此中国指责是歧视性做法。

人工智能作为软实力工具

然而，北京也将相关管控置于国际合作的语境下，以此彰显其人工智能技术的软实力影响。

北京的一处DeepSeek标志。DeepSeek的开源模型是中国实现成为人工智能超级大国雄心壮志的核心。

中国政府承诺帮助缩小全球数字鸿沟，特别是加大对世界人工智能合作组织成员国中发展中国家的支持力度。该组织由中国于今年7月发起成立，成员包括印度尼西亚、巴基斯坦和巴西等国。

曾任拜登政府国家安全委员会中国事务主管、现为哥伦比亚大学学者的朱利安·格维兹指出：“这在潜在层面相当值得关注。北京在确立管控的同时表明，它会通过一个中国支持的机制，为愿意合作的各方提供特惠待遇。”

郭莉莉(Lily Kuo)和Berry Wang对本文有报道贡献。

David Pierson报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。

Adam Satariano是时报科技记者，常驻伦敦。

翻译：纽约时报中文网

item.title: Rep. Ilhan Omar says death threats are forcing her to move after federal raid
item.description:
Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-Minn.) said she will have to move out of her apartment in Washington, D.C., because of threats she’s received after federal agents executed a search warrant at her residence last week as part of an immigration fraud probe. 

“Obviously, I can’t continue to live there … Because our address has been public and with the death threats that I deal with, it’s no longer going to be feasible to be in that house and have my kids visiting off and on, having people track them,” she told MS NOW’s Chris Hayes in a Wednesday interview. 

The congresswoman, who also has a residence in her home state of Minnesota, told Hayes she woke up at 6 a.m. on Oct. 12 to learn federal agents had “surrounded her house" in D.C. She said the agents provided her a search warrant before going “room by room” and seizing 17 items, including her phone and other electronics. 

President Trump and his administration have claimed that Omar’s father lied about her age when she obtained U.S. citizenship in 2000 after their family emigrated from Somalia.

The Democratic lawmaker has denied these allegations and accused the Trump administration of waging a “campaign of political intimidation” against her in a social media post following the raid. 

“If you had so confidently said I’ve committed a crime, why are you not saying in the beginning … we’re going to subpoena people, we’re going to do a grand jury, we’re going to try to find evidence that would lead to an indictment? It’s just it’s all bizarre,” Omar said in the Wednesday interview.

Last week, The Washington Post reported that federal officials under the first Trump administration reviewed Omar’s immigration records in 2019 but did not find evidence of fraud. 

The president has for years attacked Omar in social media posts and speeches for her political views and background. During comments to reporters in the Oval Office on Wednesday, Trump slammed Omar as a “sick, very dishonest person … who hates our country.”

“I hope they treat her fairly, but she’s a very dishonest person,” he added.

The Minnesota progressive said she has received an outpouring of support from her Democratic colleagues. She also responded to former President Obama’s statement condemning the Trump administration’s investigation into her as “appalling.” 

“I think a lot of the conspiracy world that I find myself in is the conspiracy world that was created around him, and so while some people might feel reserved in some of the information that they hear from these people, I think he is acutely capable of seeing what this is,” she said. 

Omar told MS NOW on Wednesday she feels “confident” that she has done nothing wrong. 

“I am a person of enormous faith,” she said. “And I know that … if I continue to live my truth, if I continue to fight for the right things, if I continue to stand up to bullies and people who are carrying out ungodly corruption, I’m going to be OK.”

item.title: 政治平权的台湾样本：女性凭什么赢下选举？
item.description:
袁莉
2026年10月22日

The United States view of Taiwan is often through the lens of a possible conflict with China or its dominance in advanced chip manufacturing. But behind the silicon shield is a vibrant democracy of 23 million people that was the first in Asia to legalize same-sex marriage and had a voter turnout of over 70 percent in its 2024 presidential election.

美国看待台湾的视角往往聚焦于与中国的潜在冲突，或是台湾在先进芯片制造领域的霸主地位。但在硅盾之后，是一个拥有2300万人口、充满活力的民主政体，在亚洲，它率先实现了同性婚姻合法化，在其2024年的总统选举中选民投票率超过了70%。

It has also been running one of the world’s longest experiments in political affirmative action.

台湾还一直在进行世界上持续时间最长的政治平权行动试验之一。

For decades, Taiwan has used quotas and reserved seats to bring women into electoral politics. Today its political representation by women is among the highest in the world, and, as new research suggests, few of them were ultimately elected based on quotas.

几十年来，台湾一直利用配额和保留席位将女性引入选举政治。如今，台湾女性在政治领域的代表比例位居世界前列，而且正如新的研究表明的那样，其中很少有人最终是凭借配额当选的。

Women hold 42 percent of Taiwan’s legislative seats, the highest share in Asia and comparable to Nordic countries. It elected its first female president in 2016 and re-elected her four years later. It has also elected two female vice presidents since 2000.

女性占据了台湾立法机构42%的席位，这一比例为亚洲最高，与北欧国家相当。它在2016年选出了首位女性总统，她在四年后连任。自2000年以来，台湾还选出了两位女性副总统。

“People often argue that elections should simply be about choosing the best and most capable,” said Chang-Ling Huang, a professor at National Taiwan University who has studied gender politics for more than 20 years. Taiwan’s experience shows that “gender quotas are precisely what allow a society to truly elect the best and the most capable.”

“譬如说很多人讲说要选贤与能，”国立台湾大学研究性别政治20多年的黄长玲教授表示。台湾的经验表明，“因为妇女保障名额，所以你才能真正地选贤与能”。

“Otherwise,” Ms. Huang added, “patriarchal systems simply exclude qualified women from the race.”

“不然的话，”黄长玲还说，“父权的体制就会把贤能的女人排除在外面。”

Since the 1990s, a trend of gender quotas in elections has spread around the globe, with more than 130 countries, including more than two dozen in Europe, introducing constitutional, electoral or political party quotas for women in elections, according to data from the International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance, an intergovernmental organization.

根据政府间组织民主和选举援助国际研究所的数据，自20世纪90年代以来，选举中的性别配额趋势已席卷全球，包括欧洲20多个国家在内的130多个国家在选举中为女性设立了宪法、选举法或政党层面的配额。

新北市市长候选人苏巧慧的一张竞选海报。随着台湾为11月下旬的地方选举做准备，女性候选人的海报在岛上随处可见。

But Taiwan’s approach began much earlier. In 1946, the Republic of China passed a Constitution that reserved seats for women in elections, a result of a women’s movement that dated back to the 1920s and the influence of socialism in the country, said Ms. Huang, the political scientist. When the Nationalist government was defeated in the civil war and moved to Taiwan in 1949, the quotas, set at 5 to 10 percent, were followed in local elections even though the Constitution was largely suspended during the next decades of authoritarian rule.

但台湾的做法起源要早得多。政治学家黄长玲表示，1946年，中华民国通过了一部为女性保留选举席位的宪法，这是可以追溯至20世纪20年代的女性运动以及当时社会思潮影响的结果。1949年国民政府在内战中战败并迁至台湾后，即使宪法在接下来的几十年威权统治期间大部分处于被冻结状态，但地方选举中仍遵循了这一设定为5%至10%的配额制度。

As Taiwan began to democratize in 1987, some feminist organizations worried that quotas could send a message that women were incapable of winning elections on their own merits. But they ultimately decided to lean into quotas. They fought for and succeeded in getting four rounds of major quota reforms over the next few decades.

随着台湾在1987年开始民主化，一些女权组织担心配额可能会传递出女性无法凭自身能力赢得选举的信息。但她们最终决定顺应配额制。在接下来的几十年里，她们为推动配额改革而奋斗，并成功促成了四轮重大配额改革。

A law that took effect in 2002 guarantees women a seat in local council districts electing four or more members. If, say, four men received the highest numbers of votes for a four-person council, the fourth seat would go to the female candidate with the most votes, regardless of party affiliations. So the law created an incentive for all political parties to recruit and nominate female candidates. In 2030, the quota will go up to one in three, and will be gender neutral. It means that in every three seats there must be at least one woman and one man.

2002年生效的一项法律规定，在选出四名或四名以上议员的地方议会选区中，需确保女性获得一个席位。例如，如果一个四席议会中得票最高的四名候选人均为男性，那么第四个席位将由得票最多的女性候选人获得，不论其党派背景如何。因此，该法律激励了所有政党去招募和提名女性候选人。到2030年，该配额将提高到三分之一，并将实行性别中立。这意味着每三个席位中必须至少有一名女性和一名男性。

After studying data sets from six election cycles from 2002 to 2022, Ms. Huang found that female candidates became very competitive over time. The number of electoral districts that needed to activate a reserved seat dropped from 31 in 2002 to just four in 2022.

在研究了2002年至2022年六个选举周期的数据库后，黄长玲发现，随着时间的推移，女性候选人的竞争力显著增强。需要启用保留席位的选区数量从2002年的31个降至2022年的仅四个。

Now women rarely need reserved seats to get elected, but the existence of those seats remains crucial to securing party nominations. “They serve as a safeguard, even when they go unused,” Ms. Huang said.

如今，女性候选人很少需要依靠保留席位才能当选，但这些席位的存在对于确保获得政党提名仍然至关重要。“即使没有用到，它们也起到了一种保障作用，”黄长玲说。

What if Taiwan had never adopted gender quotas? A redo of history isn’t possible, of course, but Japan provides a fairly good comparison. Women in both Japan and the Republic of China won their suffrage right after the World War II. And Taiwan’s election system resembles Japan’s. But Japan never reserved seats for women, and today women hold only 15 percent of seats in Parliament. (Women make up 28 percent of the U.S. Congress, which puts the country 84th in a global ranking of the percentage of women in national legislatures.)

如果台湾从未采用性别配额会怎样？当然，历史无法重来，但日本提供了一个相当好的对比。日本和中华民国的女性都是在二战后获得了选举权。而且台湾的选举制度与日本相似。但日本从未为女性保留席位，如今女性在国会中仅占15%的席位。（美国国会中女性占比为28%，在全球各国立法机构女性比例排名中位列第84位。）

中国国家主席习近平出席全国人民代表大会闭幕式。中国全国人大代表中女性约占四分之一，这一比例自20世纪70年代以来几乎没有变化。

Women make up about a quarter of China’s Parliament, a percentage that has barely moved since 1970s. In Xi Jinping’s third term as China’s leader, there’s not a single woman in the Communist Party’s Politburo, breaking a tradition of more than two decades. In the party’s 77 years ruling the country, no woman has ever been appointed to the Standing Committee, the pinnacle of C.C.P. power. The government under Mr. Xi has systematically tightened restrictions on feminist advocacy and movements like #MeToo.

在中国的全国人民代表大会中，女性约占四分之一，自20世纪70年代以来，这一比例几乎没有变化。在习近平作为中国领导人的第三个任期内，中共中央政治局中没有一位女性，打破了20多年来的传统。在共产党执政的77年中，从未有女性被任命为中共最高权力机构中央政治局的常务委员。习近平领导下的政府系统性地收紧了对女权倡导和#MeToo等运动的限制。

The biggest impact of the quota system in Taiwan is that it made women in political office ordinary rather than extraordinary, Ms. Huang said.

黄长玲表示，台湾配额制度最大的影响是让女性担任公职变得司空见惯，而不是凤毛麟角。

With Taiwan gearing up for local elections in late November, giant campaign posters of female candidates seem to be everywhere on the island, especially in big cities.

随着台湾为11月下旬的地方选举做准备，女性候选人的巨幅竞选海报似乎遍布全岛，尤其是在大城市。

Su Chiao-hui is running as the mayoral candidate of the ruling Democratic Progressive Party in New Taipei City, a metropolitan ring of more than four million residents that surrounds the capital city, Taipei, and is a stronghold of the opposition Nationalist Party (K.M.T.).

苏巧慧作为执政的民进党候选人正在竞选新北市市长，新北市是一个拥有400多万居民、环绕首都台北的大都会圈，也是在野党中国国民党的大本营。

It’s a high-stakes election, and Ms. Su, 50, a three-term legislator representing a district in the city, is running against Lee Shu-chuan, a 68-year-old political veteran whose English name is Hammer.

这是一场利害攸关的选举，50岁的苏巧慧曾三度当选新北市一个选区的立法委员，她正与68岁的政坛老将李四川展开角逐。

苏巧慧在台湾板桥进行竞选活动。尽管女性在选举政治中的代表性日益提高，但台湾的性别刻板印象和厌女现象并未因此消除。

Ms. Su’s party emphasizes Taiwan’s distinct identity while Mr. Lee’s party has historically tied its identity in the Republic of China that was founded in mainland in 1912. But in this local race, campaigns are intensely personal and practical. Candidates meet voters face to face and make their case on housing, child care, transportation and other everyday issues.

苏巧慧所在的政党强调台湾独特的身份认同，而李四川所在的政党在历史上将其身份认同与1912年在中国大陆成立的中华民国联系在一起。但在这次地方选举中，竞选极具个人色彩和务实性。候选人与选民面对面接触，就住房、托育、交通和其他日常议题阐述主张。

Ms. Su’s campaign embraces a feminine, maternal image — she hosts a children’s storytelling podcast — suggesting that she is comfortable with that side of herself and believes voters are, too.

苏巧慧的竞选展现出一种充满女性色彩和母性的形象——她主持着一个儿童故事的播客——这表明她对自己的这一面感到自在，并相信选民也是如此。

Her campaign office has a vibe of a children’s activity room, with pastel blocks, oversize pink lettering and cheerful cartoon figures of “Otter Mom,” her podcast. She hopes the persona projects an approachable, family-friendly image targeted at younger voters and parents who value education.

她的竞选办公室洋溢着儿童活动室的氛围，摆着柔和色彩的积木，装饰着巨大的粉红色字样和她的播客节目“水獭妈妈”中欢快的卡通形象。她希望这一形象能展现出一种平易近人、家庭友好的姿态，吸引重视教育的年轻选民和家长。

The rising women’s representation in electoral politics has not erased gender stereotypes and misogyny in Taiwan.

尽管女性在选举政治中的代表性日益提高，但台湾的性别刻板印象和厌女并未因此消失。

Yu-Yu Liu, an activist turned township head in central rural Taiwan, said that when she first ran for the office four years ago, many voters told her that, at 35, she was too young. Then almost in the same breath they would comment that she needed to hurry up to get married. She sometimes felt subtly isolated at traditional political networking gatherings where older men drank and smoked.

刘育育从活动人士转型为台湾中部农村乡长，她说四年前她第一次参选时，许多选民告诉她，35岁的她太年轻了。紧接着，他们几乎不假思索地就说她得赶紧结婚。在年长男性抽烟喝酒的传统政治社交聚会上，她有时会有一种微妙的受孤立感。

2016年，台湾首位女总统蔡英文。她曾遭受许多针对女性的攻击，还有一位对手称她为命苦的女人。

Even Tsai Ing-wen, Taiwan’s first female president, endured many misogynistic attacks. An opponent called her an ill-fated woman. She was questioned over her qualifications to understand parental issues because she’s a single, childless woman (who raised two cats and five dogs during her presidency). After her party suffered a huge defeat in the 2018 local elections, some people questioned whether she would be a one-term president.

即便是台湾首位女总统蔡英文也遭遇过许多带有厌女色彩的攻击。一位对手称她为命苦的女人。因为她单身且没有子女（在任期间养了两只猫和五只狗），她甚至被质疑是否有资格理解家长的问题。在她的政党于2018年地方选举中惨败后，有些人质疑她是否只能任职一届。

“I told myself,” she said in a recent meeting at her office, “as the first female president, I can’t fail.” She was re-elected two years later.

“我告诉自己，”前不久，她在办公室的一次会面中说，“第一次女性当总统，我不能把它当垮。”两年后，她成功连任。

袁莉为《纽约时报》撰写“新新世界”专栏，专注中国及亚洲科技、商业和政治交叉议题。

翻译：纽约时报中文网

item.title: 政治平权的台湾样本：女性凭什么赢下选举？
item.description:
袁莉
2026年10月22日

美国看待台湾的视角往往聚焦于与中国的潜在冲突，或是台湾在先进芯片制造领域的霸主地位。但在硅盾之后，是一个拥有2300万人口、充满活力的民主政体，在亚洲，它率先实现了同性婚姻合法化，在其2024年的总统选举中选民投票率超过了70%。

台湾还一直在进行世界上持续时间最长的政治平权行动试验之一。

几十年来，台湾一直利用配额和保留席位将女性引入选举政治。如今，台湾女性在政治领域的代表比例位居世界前列，而且正如新的研究表明的那样，其中很少有人最终是凭借配额当选的。

女性占据了台湾立法机构42%的席位，这一比例为亚洲最高，与北欧国家相当。它在2016年选出了首位女性总统，她在四年后连任。自2000年以来，台湾还选出了两位女性副总统。

“譬如说很多人讲说要选贤与能，”国立台湾大学研究性别政治20多年的黄长玲教授表示。台湾的经验表明，“因为妇女保障名额，所以你才能真正地选贤与能”。

“不然的话，”黄长玲还说，“父权的体制就会把贤能的女人排除在外面。”

根据政府间组织民主和选举援助国际研究所的数据，自20世纪90年代以来，选举中的性别配额趋势已席卷全球，包括欧洲20多个国家在内的130多个国家在选举中为女性设立了宪法、选举法或政党层面的配额。

新北市市长候选人苏巧慧的一张竞选海报。随着台湾为11月下旬的地方选举做准备，女性候选人的海报在岛上随处可见。

但台湾的做法起源要早得多。政治学家黄长玲表示，1946年，中华民国通过了一部为女性保留选举席位的宪法，这是可以追溯至20世纪20年代的女性运动以及当时社会思潮影响的结果。1949年国民政府在内战中战败并迁至台湾后，即使宪法在接下来的几十年威权统治期间大部分处于被冻结状态，但地方选举中仍遵循了这一设定为5%至10%的配额制度。

随着台湾在1987年开始民主化，一些女权组织担心配额可能会传递出女性无法凭自身能力赢得选举的信息。但她们最终决定顺应配额制。在接下来的几十年里，她们为推动配额改革而奋斗，并成功促成了四轮重大配额改革。

2002年生效的一项法律规定，在选出四名或四名以上议员的地方议会选区中，需确保女性获得一个席位。例如，如果一个四席议会中得票最高的四名候选人均为男性，那么第四个席位将由得票最多的女性候选人获得，不论其党派背景如何。因此，该法律激励了所有政党去招募和提名女性候选人。到2030年，该配额将提高到三分之一，并将实行性别中立。这意味着每三个席位中必须至少有一名女性和一名男性。

在研究了2002年至2022年六个选举周期的数据库后，黄长玲发现，随着时间的推移，女性候选人的竞争力显著增强。需要启用保留席位的选区数量从2002年的31个降至2022年的仅四个。

如今，女性候选人很少需要依靠保留席位才能当选，但这些席位的存在对于确保获得政党提名仍然至关重要。“即使没有用到，它们也起到了一种保障作用，”黄长玲说。

如果台湾从未采用性别配额会怎样？当然，历史无法重来，但日本提供了一个相当好的对比。日本和中华民国的女性都是在二战后获得了选举权。而且台湾的选举制度与日本相似。但日本从未为女性保留席位，如今女性在国会中仅占15%的席位。（美国国会中女性占比为28%，在全球各国立法机构女性比例排名中位列第84位。）

中国国家主席习近平出席全国人民代表大会闭幕式。中国全国人大代表中女性约占四分之一，这一比例自20世纪70年代以来几乎没有变化。

在中国的全国人民代表大会中，女性约占四分之一，自20世纪70年代以来，这一比例几乎没有变化。在习近平作为中国领导人的第三个任期内，中共中央政治局中没有一位女性，打破了20多年来的传统。在共产党执政的77年中，从未有女性被任命为中共最高权力机构中央政治局的常务委员。习近平领导下的政府系统性地收紧了对女权倡导和#MeToo等运动的限制。

黄长玲表示，台湾配额制度最大的影响是让女性担任公职变得司空见惯，而不是凤毛麟角。

随着台湾为11月下旬的地方选举做准备，女性候选人的巨幅竞选海报似乎遍布全岛，尤其是在大城市。

苏巧慧作为执政的民进党候选人正在竞选新北市市长，新北市是一个拥有400多万居民、环绕首都台北的大都会圈，也是在野党中国国民党的大本营。

这是一场利害攸关的选举，50岁的苏巧慧曾三度当选新北市一个选区的立法委员，她正与68岁的政坛老将李四川展开角逐。

苏巧慧在台湾板桥进行竞选活动。尽管女性在选举政治中的代表性日益提高，但台湾的性别刻板印象和厌女现象并未因此消除。

苏巧慧所在的政党强调台湾独特的身份认同，而李四川所在的政党在历史上将其身份认同与1912年在中国大陆成立的中华民国联系在一起。但在这次地方选举中，竞选极具个人色彩和务实性。候选人与选民面对面接触，就住房、托育、交通和其他日常议题阐述主张。

苏巧慧的竞选展现出一种充满女性色彩和母性的形象——她主持着一个儿童故事的播客——这表明她对自己的这一面感到自在，并相信选民也是如此。

她的竞选办公室洋溢着儿童活动室的氛围，摆着柔和色彩的积木，装饰着巨大的粉红色字样和她的播客节目“水獭妈妈”中欢快的卡通形象。她希望这一形象能展现出一种平易近人、家庭友好的姿态，吸引重视教育的年轻选民和家长。

尽管女性在选举政治中的代表性日益提高，但台湾的性别刻板印象和厌女并未因此消失。

刘育育从活动人士转型为台湾中部农村乡长，她说四年前她第一次参选时，许多选民告诉她，35岁的她太年轻了。紧接着，他们几乎不假思索地就说她得赶紧结婚。在年长男性抽烟喝酒的传统政治社交聚会上，她有时会有一种微妙的受孤立感。

2016年，台湾首位女总统蔡英文。她曾遭受许多针对女性的攻击，还有一位对手称她为命苦的女人。

即便是台湾首位女总统蔡英文也遭遇过许多带有厌女色彩的攻击。一位对手称她为命苦的女人。因为她单身且没有子女（在任期间养了两只猫和五只狗），她甚至被质疑是否有资格理解家长的问题。在她的政党于2018年地方选举中惨败后，有些人质疑她是否只能任职一届。

“我告诉自己，”前不久，她在办公室的一次会面中说，“第一次女性当总统，我不能把它当垮。”两年后，她成功连任。
